item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the book publisher side works.

When we track sales we look at the sales orders. We only distribute to stores after we promote the book.

To prepare for printing, Alex uses the print-ready file. 'sales orders' comes before 'prepare for printing'. For production, someone needs to format for printing.

You can't place advertisements without the marketing campaign. Sorry this is a bit all over the place. Re sales: you can't distribute to stores without the sales orders. You can't promote the book without the marketing campaign. For editing, we also edit the manuscript.

Someone needs to proofread the manuscript. For production, to format for printing, Mia uses the print-ready file. For marketing, someone needs to place advertisements.

Cheers,
Casey

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the school canteen side works.

(remind me to fix the printer). Sanitize kitchen equipment needs the cleaning supplies.

When we clean dining tables we look at the cleaning supplies.

When we clean dining tables we look at the serving trays. Honestly nobody agrees whether 'inventory list' is a inventory thing or a preparation thing. We cook dishes according to menu based on the inventory list.

How we sanitize kitchen equipment depends on how we cook dishes according to menu.

We also collect empty trays.

To serve food to students, Ana uses the serving trays.

To collect empty trays, Tom uses the serving trays. It's Raj who gets to serve food to students. You have to prepare food items before you can cook dishes according to menu.

The inventory list is Tom's job. New people always get confused by this. Mei checks the inventory list before they perform weekly inventory count.

Best,
Mei

Hi Tom,

Here's roughly how the sheep farm side works.

How we distribute feed to pens depends on how we rotate pastures. The breeding roster gets updated whenever we distribute feed to pens. You have to artificial insemination before you can shear sheep. You have to shear sheep before you can check for signs of illness.

We always treat sick animals before we administer vaccines. To rotate pastures, Sam uses the grazing pastures.

Martin owns the grazing pastures. Re shearing: the wool bales is what we go by when we shear sheep.

We also treat sick animals. On the feeding side: to mix feed batches, Sam uses the feed types. To distribute feed to pens, Tom uses the feed types.

Martin handles it when we need to artificial insemination. The breeding roster is what we go by when we administer vaccines. When we artificial insemination we look at the breeding roster.

Cheers,
Tom

Here's roughly how the golf club side works.

We run tournaments based on the event calendar. The event calendar is what we go by when we plan events.

Emily is the one who tends to update member information. Mark is the one who tends to register new members. We keep a access card.

Tom

Here's roughly how the office cleaning contractor side works.

You can't train staff on cleaning procedures without the staff roster.

You have to recruit new staff before you can train staff on cleaning procedures. We also assign staff to locations.

First we assign staff to locations, then we plan daily tasks.

Assign staff to locations needs the cleaning schedule. Lucy looks after the supply inventory.

And of course we distribute supplies to staff. The order supplies has to be sorted before the supply inventory. We distribute supplies to staff based on the supply inventory. Assign staff to locations needs the staff roster.

Cheers,
Lucy

Hi Lisa,

Here's roughly how the motorbike dealer side works.

Lisa looks after the parts stock list. Emily is the one who tends to receive parts deliveries. Order parts needs the parts stock list. You have to order parts before you can receive parts deliveries.

We show bikes to customers based on the sales inventory list. First we show bikes to customers, then we close the sale. We only close the sale after we arrange financing options. Someone needs to arrange financing options. The marketing campaign plan is what we go by when we place ads in media. Lisa checks the marketing campaign plan before they run promotional activities. You can't perform repairs without the service schedule. We might change some of this next year.

To perform maintenance, Mark uses the service schedule. We always diagnose bike issues before we perform reparis. Emily is the one who tends to perform maintenance.

Perform maintenance comes after: diagnose bike issues. To receive parts deliveries, Mark uses the service schedule. 'marketing campaign plan' comes before 'show bikes to customers'. The service schedule pulls its numbers from the parts stock list. Show bikes to customers needs the parts stock list.

Cheers,
Emily

Hi Charlie,

Here's roughly how the aquarium side works.

You have to celan aquarium and equipment before you can inspect equipment. Bob is the one who tends to clean aquarium and equipment. When we inspect equipment we look at the maintenance checklist. Alice looks after the maintenance checklist. When we treat sick fish we look at the health logs.

Visually inspect fish needs the health logs.

Adjust water chemistry comes after: test water parameters. Count the fish needs the fish inventory. Bob checks the health logs before they count the fish. You have to adjust water chemistry before you can feed the fish. The fish inventory is what we go by when we test water parameters. Visually inspect fish comes after: observe feeding behavior.

First we feed the fish, then we observe feeding behavior.

When we feed the fish we look at the feeding schedule.

Best,
Alice

Cheers,
Mark

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the dance school side works.

For evaluation, evaluate student performance needs the feedback report. The feedback report is what we go by when we rank students in levels. We always correct student's technique before we rank students in levels.

The dance routines is filled in when we rehearse performance.

The dance syllabus is what we go by when we rank students in levels.

How we schedule classes depends on how we teach dance moves. Re curriculum: you can't schedule classes without the dance syllabus. To schedule classes, Ryan uses the dance routines. Ryan checks the costume list before they rehearse performance.

To rehearse performance, Mia uses the performance calendar. We talked about this at the last meeting too. On the instruction side: the demonstration video is what we go by when we correct student's technique.

To teach dance moves, Mia uses the demonstration video. Emma handles it when we need to correct student's technique. Mia handles it when we need to teach dance moves.

Thanks,
Ryan

Hi Sarah,

Here's roughly how the window cleaning round side works.

There's also the property list.

Clean windows relies on whoever does the job to access properties. We access properties based on the property list. We update availability based on the weekly schedule.

When we assign tasks to cleaners we look at the weekly schedule. This has grown over the years. The quality checklist is Lisa's job.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. You can't inspect windows without the quality checklist.

We always clean windows before we inspect windows.

We assign tasks to cleaners based on the property list. Check equipment needs input from: access porperties. The cleaning kit is what we go by when we check equipment.

Cheers,
Mike

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the solar panel installer side works.

There's also the installation tools. First we mount racking system, then we install solar panels. Jamie handles it when we need to install solar panels. Casey checks the system layout before they optimize panel orientation. Alex is the one who tends to optimize panel orientation. 'measure roof dimensions' comes before 'site survey report'. The assess shading has to be sorted before the site survey report. We always connect panels to inverter before we wire to electrical panel.

There's also the solar inverter. We also connect panels to inverter. Wire to electrical panel needs input from: check system compliance.

Mount racking system relies on whoever does the job to connect panels to inverter. We measure roof dimensions based on the system layout. We test electrical connections based on the system layout.

The system layout comes out of the step where we install solar panels.

Assess shading needs input from: optimize panel orientation.

To test electrical connections, Casey uses the inspection certificate. Test electrical connections comes after: check system compliance.

Thanks,
Alex

Linda

It's Ben who gets to sign the artefacts. Sign the artefacts comes after: build release artefacts.

The changelog is built from the release milestone. There's also the release milestone.

The release milestone is what we go by when we triage incoming issues.

The roadmap is what we go by when we triage incoming issues.

Thanks,
Chen

Here's roughly how the scout group side works.

The budget plan gets updated whenever we perform community service.

It mostly works, honestly.

Best,
Alice

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the scout group side works.

Half of this lives in people's heads.

Teach new skills needs the scout manual.

To plan group activities, Ben uses the event calendar. Diana looks after the event calendar.

Event calendar depends on: lead outdoor activities. Diana looks after the first aid kit. Diana owns the first aid kit.

We only lead outdoor activities after we teach new skills. We perform community service based on the community projects. Perform community service needs the community contact list.

The budget plan gets updated whenever we perform community service.

It mostly works, honestly.

The budget plan is what we go by when we plan group activities. We lead outdoor activities based on the trail map.

Best,
Alice

We always place order for ingredients before we check deliveries. Place order for ingredients needs the supplier list. And of course we clean equipment. The inventory list comes out of the step where we portion ingredients.

We only clean equipment after we cook meals.

Best,
Mei

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the travel agency side works.

Parking is a nightmare btw. We coordinate services based on the daily schedule.

You can't record financial transactions without the payment invoice. The travel itinerary draws on the daily schedule.

When we make bookings we look at the travel itinerary. Track customer progress needs the daily schedule.

To record financial transactions, Olivia uses the frequently asked questions. We arrange transportation based on the travel itinerary. Lisa looks after the frequently asked questions. You can't make bookings without the daily schedule. Emma checks the payment invoice before they process payments.

The frequently asked questions is what we go by when we resolve issues. You have to track customer progress before you can resolve issues. Emma owns the payment invoice.

Thanks,
John

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the yoga studio side works.

On the instruction side: teach yoga classes needs the teaching guide. To assist individual customers, Ben uses the teaching guide. You have to confirm registration before you can teach yoga classes.

On the scheduling side: the class schedule is what we go by when we update calendar as needed. Ben is in charge when we update calendar as needed.

Post on social media needs the promotional flyer. The class schedule is what we go by when we assign instructors to classes. Re cleaning: we restock supplies based on the cleaning checklist. To send email newsletters, Priya uses the promotional flyer. 'clean studio after classes' comes before 'class schedule'. Collect payment comes after: post on social media.

To assign instructors to classes we need the result of the step where we teach yoga classes. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. When we confirm registration we look at the customer registration form. Teach yoga classes comes after: restock supplies.

We collect payment based on the customer registration form. We also confirm registration.

You can't clean studio after classes without the cleaning checklist.

Best,
Alex

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the open source project side works.

First we review PRs, then we merge PRs.

Review PRs needs the contributing guide.

The community chat is Rafa's job. To run CI, Lin uses the test matrix. And of course we run CI. To triage issues, Lin uses the issue tracker. Lin is in charge when we triage issues. And of course we label issues. Releases — there's also the changelog.

Rafa checks the test matrix before they tag the release. Maintain docs needs the contributing guide. Changelog depends on: merge PRs. The community chat is what we go by when we triage issues. It mostly works, honestly.

To review PRs we need the result of the step where we run CI. You can't merge PRs without the issue tracker.

Best,
Rafa

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the esports team side works.

You can't analyze team and opponent strategies without the match strategy.

Recruitment criteria is based on the training schedule.

How we analyze player performance depends on how we practice match scenarios.

Analytics — you can't analyze player performance without the performance dashboard. Re match: Casey looks after the match lineup. We conduct player interviews based on the recruitment criteria. We always track match data before we analyze player performance.

We only conduct player interviews after we scout potential players. You have to check player health before you can provide coaching. The psychological playbook is what we go by when we provide coaching. You can't analyze team and opponent strategies without the training schedule.

When we practice match scenarios we look at the training schedule.

Training schedule is based on the match strategy.

Cheers,
Tyler

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the cricket club side works.

On the matches side: Sarah is the one who tends to schedule matches. How we check equipment depends on how we conduct training sessions. To maintain equipment we need the result of the step where we schedule matches. Collect fees comes after: pay expenses.

We also arrange matches. New people always get confused by this. Lisa handles it when we need to maintain equipment. To register new members we need the result of the step where we collect fees. You can't arrange matches without the match fixtures. Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

You have to plan training sessions before you can conduct training sessions. Register new members needs the list of members. Financial accounts depends on: maintain equipment. To collect fees, Tom uses the financial accounts. You have to arrange matches before you can schedule matches. We check equipment based on the equipment inventory.

Re finance: it's Ryan who gets to collect fees. Conduct training sessions comes after: schedule matches. On the equipment side: the equipment inventory is what we go by when we maintain equipment.

Tom checks the training schedule before they plan training sessions. The training schedule pulls its numbers from the match fixtures.

Best,
Jamie

Here's roughly how the debt collection agency side works.

This has grown over the years.

Cheers,
Mike

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the credit union side works.

The deposit account is what we go by when we report findings. We update account balances based on the deposit account. Michael is the one who tends to report findings.

You have to open new accounts before you can update account balances. There's a customer inquiry. Emily owns the loan application. We report findings based on the compliance audit. We might change some of this next year. Report findings comes after: review operations. It mostly works, honestly.

On the loan processing side: and of course we approve loan.

Emily checks the loan application before they report findings.

Best,
Sarah

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the council parking enforcement side works.

You can't conduct investigations without the violation report. This has grown over the years.

There's also the appeal form. To spot violations we need the result of the step where we track repeat offenders.

We always update policies before we issue tickets.

And of course we resolve appeals.

Conduct investigations comes after: track repeat offenders. New people always get confused by this. Carol is the one who tends to issue fines. The violation report comes out of the step where we issue tickets.

We also spot violations.

Someone needs to track repeat offenders.

You can't resolve appeals without the appeal form. You have to spot violations before you can issue tickets. The ticket gets updated whenever we review appeals.

When we issue tickets we look at the ticket. When we collect payemnts we look at the payment record.

The payment record comes out of the step where we issue tickets. First we issue fines, then we collect payments. You have to review appeals before you can resolve appeals. The ticket is filled in when we issue fines.

Best,
Dave

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the skip hire company side works.

The usage log is what we go by when we place skips according to plan. The booking calendar pulls its numbers from the delivery manifest. Place skips according to plan comes after: assign equipment based on booking. We report any issues based on the usage log. On the booking side: we assign equipment based on booking based on the booking calendar. There's a delivery manifest. We also assign equipment based on booking. We confirm booking details based on the booking calendar. Setup — you can't place skips according to plan without the site plan. Delivery — and of course we transport skips to site.

Cheers,
Lisa

Hello,

Here's roughly how the hospital kitchen side works.

You can't plan daily menu without the weekly schedule. You can't plan daily menu without the dietary guidelines.

Mei is the one who tends to plan daily menu. We always order food before we receive deliveries. To oredr food, Ana uses the supplier list. There's also the supplier list.

There's a prep list. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense.

We cook dishes based on the prep list. Mei is in charge when we portion food.

First we cook dishes, then we portion food. How we plan daily menu depends on how we cook dishes. How we receive deliveries depends on how we clean equipment. Deliver meals needs input from: clean equipment. To portion food we need the result of the step where we deliver meals.

To receive deliveries we need the result of the step where we cook dishes. Re distribution: deliver meals needs the delivery schedule. And of course we clean equipment.

Clean equipment needs the cleaning schedule.

Best,
Raj

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the notary office side works.

Edit document for accuracy relies on whoever does the job to verify client identity.

How we log notarizations depends on how we charge for notarial services. To witness signatures we need the result of the step where we log notarizations. To collect payment we need the result of the step where we store notarized documents. Re client consultation: the client information form is what we go by when we advise on notarial requirements.

Record keeping — we also store notarized documents. The coffee machine is broken again.

We talked about this at the last meeting too.

Store notarized documents needs the notary records.

When we log notarizations we look at the notary records.

Best,
Emma

Hello,

Here's roughly how the fireworks display side works.

You have to collect debris before you can dispose of debris. It's Tom who gets to dispose of debris. Clear the site comes after: dispose of debris. When we layout the sites we look at the launch sites. The launch sites comes out of the step where we fire the fireworks. The required permits has to be sorted before the display schedule. Check deliveries relies on whoever does the job to layout the sites. Display schedule depends on: layout the sites. Raj checks the safety perimeters before they layout the sites. Check deliveries relies on whoever does the job to order fireworks. The firing sequence is what we go by when we fire the fireworks.

The display schedule is what we go by when we design fireworks sequences.

Best,
Mei

item.input:
Hi Emily,

Here's roughly how the council licensing office side works.

Enforcement — 'investigate violations' comes before 'enforcement notice'. And of course we investigate violations.

First we issue license, then we notify applicant of decision. The issue license has to be sorted before the license document. To issue license we need the result of the step where we investigate violations.

The enforcement notice has to be sorted before the review application completeness. First we review application completeness, then we validate application details. There's also the licensing application.

We also conduct site inspection.

Thanks,
David

Here's roughly how the homeless shelter side works.

'community resource list' comes before 'individual support plan'. We only provide case management after we provide check-ups. It mostly works, honestly. We only provide check-ups after we inspect shelters. How we conduct life skills training depends on how we connect residents to resources.

You can't assign shelter space without the shelter list.

You can't inspect shelters without the shelter list.

This has grown over the years. Maria is the one who tends to inspect shelters. We only register individuals after we conduct initial assessment.

There's a medication list. Alan checks the medication list before they provide check-ups. Provide check-ups comes after: provide therapy sessions.

Best,
Sarah

Hello,

Here's roughly how the school library side works.

Select new books relies on whoever does the job to place orders with suppliers. Liam is the one who tends to sort books by category. The checkout records is what we go by when we lend books to students. You can't accept book returns without the checkout records. Liam checks the checkout records before they place books on shelves. How we accept book returns depends on how we place books on shelves.

It's Noah who gets to place books on shelves. When we place books on shelves we look at the shelf locations. Liam is in charge when we sort books by category. Place orders with suppliers relies on whoever does the job to place orders with suppliers.

The shelf locations is what we go by when we sort books by category.

Cheers,
Emma

Here's roughly how the machine learning team side works.

We keep a deployment configuration. To deploy to production, Priya uses the deployment configuration. Mei checks the deployment configuration before they monitor performance. First we deploy to production, then we monitor performance. Someone needs to review documentation. We only review documentation after we write documentation. First we collect data from sources, then we validate data quality.

New people always get confused by this. First we conduct testing, then we review results. Raj is in charge when we clean data. We also clean data. It's Mei who gets to train the model. We only validate the model's performance after we train the model. The deployment configuration comes out of the step where we write documentation. We only review documentation after we review results. To collect data from sources we need the result of the step where we clean data. The data schema is filled in when we train the model. The coffee machine is broken again.

Thanks,
Priya

Hello,

Here's roughly how the butcher shop side works.

The meat display is Sarah's job. There's also the meat display.

Serve customers needs the cash register. Tom is in charge when we prepare display.

We keep a cut list. We only reorder stock after we count stock daily. Half of this lives in people's heads. Record sales comes after: serve customers.

Prepare display needs the meat display. We always serve customers before we count stock daily. New people always get confused by this.

The stock levels is what we go by when we count stock daily.

Thanks,
David

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the concert promoter side works.

The current roster draws on the ticket sale links.

On the ticketing side: someone needs to set up ticketing system. You can't set up ticketing system without the ticket sale links.

The venue contract pulls its numbers from the event schedule.

We always scout potential venues before we negotiate venue terms.

Current roster is based on the social media ad.

Re marketing: Carlos checks the social media ad before they launch promotional campaign.

When we launch promotional campaign we look at the ticket sale links.

The ticket sale links is Carlos's job. On the venue side: you can't negotiate venue terms without the venue contract. Launch promotional campaign needs input from: set up ticketing system. We also negotiate venue terms.

Carlos checks the current roster before they negotiate contract terms.

You have to identify potential acts before you can negotiate contract terms.

Cheers,
Bella

We always 监测天气 bfeore we 报告天气. Beth checks the 无线电设备 before they 通知相关机构. The 物资清单 is what we go by when we 管理库存.

To 报告天气, Carlos uses the 天气预报. We talked about this at the last meeting too.

The 物资清单 draws on the 救援装备.

Emily

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the photography studio side works.

When we upload to cloud storage we look at the cloud storage. You can't review and refine edits without the editing software.

Re storage: the external drive is what we go by when we back up photos to drive. For sales, Emma is the one who tends to present the portfolio to client. How we finalize client selection depends on how we back up photos to drive. Mark is the one who tends to back up photos to drive. Editing — we always edit photos before we review and refine edits. We schedule photo sessions based on the booking calendar.

How we review and refine edits depends on how we finalize client selection. The booking calendar gets updated whenever we present the portfolio to client. First we edit photos, then we upload to cloud storage.

First we present the portfolio to client, then we finalize client selection.

Cheers,
Emma

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the mobile app release team side works.

The rollback plan is what we go by when we monitor user feedback.

Monitor user feedback comes after: deploy to app store. Lisa is the one who tends to build app binary. We also sign the app. We always build app binary before we sign the app. To code review, Lisa uses the feature branch. You have to write code before you can code review.

Build app binary comes after: perform manual QA. To run continuous integration, Lisa uses the feature branch.

The product backlog gets updated whenever we write code. Jordan checks the feature branch before they build app binary.

The release changelog is built from the product roadmap. Deploy to app store comes after: sign the app. Sam checks the product backlog before they prioritize tasks. The product roadmap is Lisa's job. We prioritize tasks based on the product roadmap. You have to run continuous integration before you can perform manual QA. This has grown over the years. To perform manual QA, Mike uses the test plan. It mostly works, honestly.

Thanks,
Sam

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the steel fabrication shop side works.

How we cut to dimensions depends on how we measure cuts.

The detailed blueprint is what we go by when we model parts in CAD.

And of course we model parts in CAD. When we add dimensions we look at the detailed blueprint. We always model parts in CAD before we add dimensions. Tom checks the finished parts before they final inspection. You have to polish surfaces before you can final inspection. The finished parts is what we go by when we polish surfaces. You can't bend steel without the shaped parts. The detailed blueprint pulls its numbers from the shaped parts.

The shaped parts is built from the finished parts.

Cheers,
Sarah

Hi Jamie,

Here's roughly how the facilities management side works.

Morgan looks after the supply inventory. To store supplies, Jamie uses the supply inventory. We also patrol grounds. How we replenish stock depends on how we sweep floors. To inspect equipment, Alex uses the cleaning roster.

We monitor security cameras based on the maintenance schedule.

We sweep floors based on the maintenance schedule. Alex checks the compliance checklist before they check access logs. To report findings, Casey uses the compliance checklist.

This has grown over the years. How we replenish stock depends on how we repair faulty components. You can't order supplies without the supply inventory. Repair faulty components needs the maintenance schedule. 'inspect equipment' comes before 'maintenance schedule'. We replace parts based on the maintenance schedule.

You can't replenish stock without the supply inventory.

It's Casey who gets to repair faulty components. Casey handles it when we need to monitor security cameras. We sweep floors based on the cleaning roster. You can't sanitize high-touch areas without the cleaning roster.

Repair faulty components needs input from: order supplies.

Best,
Casey

Hello,

Here's roughly how the probation service side works.

When we assess risk and needs we look at the case file.

We always conduct interviews before we assess risk and needs. When we conduct interviews we look at the case file. We only assess risk and needs after we hold supervision meetings. The case file is built from the supervision schedule. The case file is built from the rehabilitation plan. How we assess risk and needs depends on how we compile data. The support records is what we go by when we enroll in programs. You can't offer support services without the support records. For reporting, we always compile data before we write report. The probation report is what we go by when we write report. Someone needs to enroll in programs. Mark owns the rehabilitation plan. We keep a rehabilitation plan. Sarah checks the rehabilitation plan before they enroll in programs.

We also hold supervision meetings. Hold supervision meetings needs the supervision schedule.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Ava,

Here's roughly how the youth hostel side works.

The cleaning schedule is Noah's job. To clean rooms, Noah uses the cleaning schedule. You can't clean common areas without the cleaning schedule. Prepare meals relies on whoever does the job to clean common areas. There's also the access log. We monitor entrance/exits based on the access log. Noah handles it when we need to prepare meals.

Noah checks the access log before they patrol grounds. You can't clean rooms without the maintenance list.

You can't fix issues without the maintenance list. Olivia checks the maintenance list before they routine maintenance.

Cheers,
Olivia

Hello,

Here's roughly how the cemetery management side works.

Fill the plot comes after: place the casket.

Place the casket comes after: dig the plot. Alice handles it when we need to dig the plot. I'll tidy this up later. The maintenance schedule comes out of the step where we mow the grass. Fill the plot relies on whoever does the job to install gravestones.

We bill for services based on the maintenance schedule. Gravestone inventory is based on the burial records. The burial schedule is filled in when we dig the plot. When we bill for services we look at the service contracts.

When we bill for services we look at the burial records. First we mow the grass, then we prune plants. To prune plants we need the result of the step where we plant flowers. Dave is the one who tends to mow the grass. When we allocate plots we look at the maintenance schedule. Allocate plots needs the burial schedule. Bob is in charge when we allocate plots. We install gravestones based on the gravestone inventory.

You can't clean memorials without the gravestone inventory.

Someone needs to install gravestones. We keep a gravestone inventory.

Best,
Dave

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the fireworks display side works.

The launch sites is what we go by when we layout the sites.

The safety perimeters is what we go by when we layout the sites.

We always time the cues before we fire the fireworks. It's Raj who gets to monitor the perimeter. Inspect equipment needs the safety protocols. Tom checks the safety protocols before they monitor the perimeter.

Safety equipment depends on: inspect equipment.

The launch sites is filled in when we fire the fireworks. The display schedule is filled in when we layout the sites. To check deliveries we need the result of the step where we layout the sites. The display schedule comes out of the step where we time the cues. To monitor the perimeter we need the result of the step where we time the cues.

Safety protocols depends on: time the cues.

Clear the site comes after: time the cues. Raj is in charge when we clear the site. Tom is the one who tends to collect debris. We design fireworks sequences based on the display schedule. The required permits has to be sorted before the display schedule.

Mark looks after the required permits. Mark looks after the display schedule.

To check deliveries we need the result of the step where we order fireworks.

The safety equipment is what we go by when we order fireworks.

Cheers,
Tom

Hello,

Here's roughly how the medical device manufacturer side works.

Lisa is in charge when we refine design based on feedback. Sorry this is a bit all over the place. The test protocol pulls its numbers from the quality inspection report.

The compliance documentation draws on the test protocol.

For quality control, we correct any issues found based on the quality control report. 'draft initial design' comes before 'technical specifications'.

Document test results relies on whoever does the job to correct any issues found. The assembly instructions comes out of the step where we perform quality inspections. For design, Rafael checks the technical specifications before they refine design based on feedback. The perform quality inspections has to be sorted before the quality control report. Lisa looks after the marketing campaign plan. The quality control report draws on the quality inspection report.

On the manufacturing side: assemble device needs the assembly instructions. The technical specifications gets updated whenever we perform quality inspections. The technical specifications pulls its numbers from the assembly instructions.

Manufacturing — the assemble device has to be sorted before the quality inspection report. Andrew owns the quality inspection report. Re marketing: there's a marketing brochure.

Thanks,
Lisa

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the charity shop side works.

We process sales based on the sales register.

Michael is the one who tends to assist customers. Emma checks the sales register before they assist customers.

Michael is the one who tends to receive donations. To sort donations, Lisa uses the donation log. We only sort donations after we receive donations. We also clean items.

Michael checks the cleaning schedule before they prepare items for display. Prepare items for display comes after: clean items. How we prepare items for display depends on how we assist customers. When we process sales we look at the cleaning schedule. The sales register is what we go by when we set price. Emma checks the inventory list before they receive donations.

We sort donations based on the inventory list. Lisa checks the pricing guide before they set price. First we assess item condition, then we set price.

Best,
Lisa

Sarah

Hello,

Here's roughly how the mosque community centre side works.

We keep a prayer schedule. The event flyer is what we go by when we announce events on social media.

We teach classes based on the educational resource.

We might change some of this next year.

We lead prayers based on the call to prayer. (remind me to fix the printer). Fatima is the one who tends to lead prayers.

You can't lead prayers without the prayer schedule.

There's a call to prayer. Lead prayers comes after: teach classes. Ali is the one who tends to distribute flyers in the community.

Re worship: the prayer schedule is Aisha's job. For outreach, distribute flyers in the community comes after: announce events on social media.

Best,
Aisha

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the steel fabrication shop side works.

We only final inspection after we polish surfaces. Weld parts together comes after: bend steel. You can't polish surfaces without the finished parts. The finished parts is what we go by when we weld parts together. Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

We model parts in CAD based on the detailed blueprint. Add dimensions needs the detailed blueprint. Detailed blueprint is based on the shaped parts.

First we model parts in CAD, then we add dimensions.

Tom is the one who tends to measure cuts. The shaped parts pulls its numbers from the finished parts. First we fit parts together, then we check for alignment. Tom is the one who tends to add dimensions. The finished parts gets updated whenever we fit parts together. The shaped parts is what we go by when we bend steel. To final inspection, Lisa uses the finished parts. Tom is the one who tends to bend steel. Sarah checks the shaped parts before they weld parts together.

Thanks,
Mike

Cheers,
Mike

John is the one who tends to conduct drills. Lisa is in charge when we conduct drills. We only conduct knowledge tests after we conduct drills.

Cheers,
Lisa

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the hospital ward side works.

When we take observations we look at the obs chart. Admissions — we admit patients based on the bed board.

For discharge, 'plan discharge' comes before 'discharge letter'. To dispense drugs, Dr Mensah uses the ward drug stock. The bed board is what we go by when we plan discharge.

The ward drug stock is what we go by when we give medicines.

We do the ward round based on the obs chart.

Cheers,
Sister Ward

Here's roughly how the it outsourcing provider side works.

David is in charge when we document solutions. The frequently asked questions is what we go by when we document solutions. You have to troubleshoot issues before you can document solutions. Assign tasks to team members needs the team member availability. Sorry this is a bit all over the place. We keep a team member skills database. The project timeline is Emily's job. Carlos checks the team member skills database before they assign tasks to team members. John checks the quality standards document before they review deliverables.

Thanks,
Lisa

Hi Dot,

Here's roughly how the plumbing business side works.

Half of this lives in people's heads. Not sure this is all of it but here goes. On the jobs side: someone needs to fit the boiler. We always fit the boiler before we issue a gas certificate.

Send invoices comes after: issue a gas certificate.

You can't fit the boiler without the written quote. The written quote is what we go by when we send invoices.

Dot checks the van stock list before they fit the boiler. For stock, the van stock list is what we go by when we buy from the merchant.

Terry owns the written quote. There's a written quote. When we send invoices we look at the accounts book. Terry is the one who tends to schedule jobs.

Best,
Dot

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the vineyard tasting room side works.

We process payment based on the wine inventory list.

We only sell wines to guests after we explain wine notes.

First we package wine orders, then we process payment. Process payment needs the sales receipt. First we process payment, then we give receipt to guest. It's Emma who gets to welcome guests. We always welcome guests before we direct to tasting area. When we welcome guests we look at the guest register. We keep a tasting menu. Chris owns the tasting menu. When we sell wines to guests we look at the wine inventory list. First we sell wines to guests, then we package wine orders.

Cheers,
Jake

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the butcher shop side works.

We order meat supplies based on the supplier list.

We talked about this at the last meeting too.

We only receive deliveries after we order meat supplies. David checks the stock levels before they count stock daily. The stock levels is David's job.

Mike checks the meat display before they prepare display. When we rotate inventory we look at the meat display.

Laura checks the stock levels before they receive deliveries.

We only count stock daily after we serve customers. Cut meat needs the meat display. To wrap meat portions we need the result of the step where we serve customers. David checks the stock levels before they order meat supplies. The coffee machine is broken again. You have to cut meat before you can wrap meat portions. To cut meat, Sarah uses the cut list. You can't serve customers without the cash register. We only record sales after we serve customers.

Thanks,
Mike

'survey the job' comes before 'written quote'.

Hello,

Here's roughly how the campsite side works.

We only set up campsite facilities after we clean campsite areas.

We repair facilities based on the supply inventory. Set up campsite facilities needs input from: assist in activities. Mike checks the supply inventory before they set up campsite facilities. Lisa is in charge when we prepare meals. The activity calendar pulls its numbers from the activity list.

Tom owns the activity list. We only serve meals after we prepare meals. The maintenance log is what we go by when we inspect facilities.

To serve meals we need the result of the step where we inspect facilities. Schedule activities needs the activity calendar.

Serve meals needs the meal menu.

And of course we serve meals. We also repair facilities. To set up campsite facilities, Mike uses the meal menu.

The resource allocation is what we go by when we clean campsite areas.

First we inspect facilities, then we repair facilities. The activity calendar is filled in when we inspect facilities. The resource allocation is what we go by when we schedule activities.

We keep a activity calendar.

We respond to incidents based on the emergency contact list. We always patrol campsite areas before we respond to incidents. When we patrol campsite areas we look at the maintenance log.

Cheers,
Mike

Hi John,

Here's roughly how the tea room side works.

You can't update stock levels without the inventory ledger. How we record transactions depends on how we place orders.

Accounting — the record transactions has to be sorted before the accounting ledger. We always select tea varieties before we place orders. The inventory ledger is what we go by when we place orders.

Peter checks the cleaning schedule before they sweep floors. Sarah handles it when we need to update stock levels. To record transactions we need the result of the step where we update stock levels. For inventory, Sarah is the one who tends to update stock levels. You can't wipe surfaces without the cleaning schedule.

You can't place orders without the supplier contacts.

Cheers,
John

Someone needs to log repair work. Lisa is in charge when we log repair work.

Charge patient or insurance needs the repair log. We take measurements based on the written prescription. How we conduct eye examination depends on how we explain prescription details.

We only discuss options with patient after we conduct eye examination. We conduct eye examination based on the patient records. Not sure this is all of it but here goes. New people always get confused by this.

And of course we discuss options with patient.

Best,
Mark

Tom checks the shaped parts before they weld parts together.

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the christmas market side works.

First we load goods onto trucks, then we deliver goods to stalls.

Olivia checks the inventory stock before they deliver goods to stalls.

First we install lighting and decorations, then we arrange stalls and decorations. You can't sell items without the sales receipts. You have to serve customers before you can sell items. First we sell items, then we clean stalls and area. To arrange stalls and decorations we need the result of the step where we dismantle stalls. Sarah is in charge when we sell items.

Restock items relies on whoever does the job to sell items.

Liam is the one who tends to clean stalls and area.

Liam is in charge when we serve customers.

Dismantle stalls comes after: clean stalls and area. Liam is the one who tends to sell items. We install lighting and decorations based on the market permits. Liam checks the inventory stock before they restock items.

The cleanup checklist is what we go by when we dismantle stalls. It mostly works, honestly.

Thanks,
Noah

Hi Alex,

Here's roughly how the shoe repair shop side works.

Polish shoes relies on whoever does the job to finish the repair. How we prepare materials depends on how we fix the shoes.

John is in charge when we diagnose issues. When we package the shoes we look at the invoice.

John looks after the pricing rates. We fix the shoes based on the repair tools. Fix the shoes needs the assessment report. We keep a repair tools.

Half of this lives in people's heads.

We only finish the repair after we fix the shoes.

Package the shoes relies on whoever does the job to polish shoes. We only package the shoes after we polish shoes.

You can't diagnose issues without the assessment report.

We also diagnose issues. We always select materials before we prepare materials. We prepare materials based on the materials stock.

Cheers,
Maria

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the book publisher side works.

'edit the manuscript' comes before 'book design mockup'. This has grown over the years. The book design mockup draws on the print-ready file.

Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

Re production: prepare for printing needs the print-ready file. When we format for printing we look at the print-ready file. It's Ryan who gets to format for printing.

To place advertisements, Mia uses the marketing campaign. When we promote the book we look at the marketing campaign. You can't proofread the manuscript without the book manuscript. The book manuscript is Mia's job. Edit the manuscript needs the book manuscript.

For design, the book design mockup is what we go by when we design cover. Design layout needs the book design mockup.

Cheers,
Casey

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the youth football league side works.

Refereeing — Jamie checks the referee roster before they assign referees. The team roster draws on the match schedule.

This has grown over the years. The match schedule pulls its numbers from the match score. Re communication: when we send reminders we look at the league updates.

'referee training' comes before 'league updates'. To send reminders, Sam uses the email list. The match score is what we go by when we supervise matches.

'assign referees' comes before 'referee training'. You can't assign venues without the match calendar. The coffee machine is broken again.

The registration fees has to be sorted before the match calendar. We also send reminders. Laura checks the match report before they supervise matches. How we assign referees depends on how we supervise matches. On the scheduling side: the match schedule is built from the match calendar.

Thanks,
Jamie

Hello,

Here's roughly how the heritage railway side works.

We also check bookings. It's Noah who gets to check bookings. Preservation — Noah is in charge when we store historical artefacts. Sell tickets relies on whoever does the job to operate the train. Store historical artefacts needs the historical archive.

We also operate the train.

To communicate with control we need the result of the step where we operate the train. Repair any damages needs the maintenance records. When we store historical artefacts we look at the maintenance records. Noah looks after the crew roster.

To operate the train, Emma uses the crew roster. Repair any damages relies on whoever does the job to operate the train.

We might change some of this next year. Half of this lives in people's heads.

Isabella

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the mobile game studio side works.

You have to brainstorm game concepts before you can select final game concept. When we submit to app stores we look at the app store submission.

We runs beta testing based on the list of bugs.

Runs unit tests needs input from: write game code. 'design game mechanics' comes before 'design document'. You have to runs unit tests before you can runs beta testing.

We also design visual elements.

You have to promote the game before you can release marketing materials.

To integrate features, Sam uses the game codebase. We always runs beta testing before we promote the game.

We keep a app store submission. You have to submit to app stores before you can release marketing materials. We always design visual elements before we integrate features. Select final game concept needs the design document. We always promote the game before we runs unit tests.

The write game code has to be sorted before the game codebase. When we select final game concept we look at the list of game ideas. There's also the list of game ideas. When we promote the game we look at the marketing plan. 'design visual elements' comes before 'design document'.

Best,
Sam

Here's roughly how the archaeological dig side works.

We keep a site map. Ethan is in charge when we locate potential areas. You can't measure dimensions of the site without the site map. Ethan checks the site map before they locate potential areas. The site map is what we go by when we conduct excavations. How we label artifacts depends on how we study artifacts.

The analysis report is filled in when we clean artifacts. Measure dimensions of the site needs the excavation trenches. When we conduct excavations we look at the excavation trenches. Document findings needs the analysis report. Someone needs to study artifacts. You have to study artifacts before you can document findings. First we clean artifacts, then we store artifacts.

You can't store artifacts without the storage solutions.

Input data into the catalog needs the artifact catalog. First we label artifacts, then we input data into the catalog.

Thanks,
Bob

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the kitchen fitter side works.

You can't connect plumbing components without the plumbing fixtures.

Casey looks after the plumbing fixtures.

The layout plan is what we go by when we customize design details. There's also the layout plan.

We measure the space based on the layout plan. Assemble units needs input from: connect electrical components. How we assemble units depends on how we connect plumbing components. Connect plumbing components needs the final fixtures.

The layout plan pulls its numbers from the kitchen units. You can't connect electrical components without the final fixtures. Casey is the one who tends to install units. Jamie handles it when we need to install units.

You have to assemble units before you can install units.

We install units based on the kitchen units. Measure the space needs the material list. Measure the space needs the kitchen blueprint. The electrical wiring is what we go by when we connect electrical components. We connect electrical components based on the power sockets.

Alex is the one who tends to clean the workspace.

Thanks,
Olivia

Jonathan checks the decorations before they set up venue. We only remove decorations after we set up venue.

We keep a guest list. David is the one who tends to prepare for service. Sarah checks the Torah readings before they prepare for service. To prepare for service, Rachel uses the blessings list.

Best,
David

Robin

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the short film production side works.

We only mix sound after we edit the cut. Zara owns the production budget. First we edit the cut, then we colour grade. Mo checks the production budget before they scout locations.

When we hold auditions we look at the shooting script. The shooting schedule pulls its numbers from the shooting script. The call sheet draws on the cast list. It's Zara who gets to mix sound. Call sheet is based on the shooting schedule. There's a cast list.

Rewrite the script needs the shooting script. You can't hold auditions without the cast list.

Best,
Mo

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the fishmonger side works.

How we sell fish depends on how we record sales. You can't source fish without the supplier list.

Ethan owns the supplier list. We always cut fish before we sell fish. Record sales needs the sales ledger.

'reconcile accounts' comes before 'supplier list'.

Someone needs to cut fish. Liam is the one who tends to source fish. You have to inspect quality before you can check freshness. Isabella handles it when we need to inspect quality. Ethan checks the customer list before they sell fish. You can't cut fish without the cut types. Source fish needs input from: store fish.

The sales ledger is what we go by when we reconcile accounts. We service customers based on the customer list. First we source fish, then we inspect quality.

You have to clean fish before you can cut fish. Ethan is the one who tends to inspect quality.

Cheers,
Olivia

Here's roughly how the shoe repair shop side works.

The materials stock is what we go by when we prepare materials.

First we select materials, then we prepare materials. There's a materials stock. Maria checks the assessment report before they diagnose issues. We also finish the repair. Prepare materials relies on whoever does the job to fix the shoes. The assessment report is what we go by when we calculate cost. Maria cehcks the invoice before they package the shoes. We also calculate cost. You can't calculate cost without the pricing rates. 'calculate cost' comes before 'invoice'.

Best,
Maria

Here's roughly how the maternity unit side works.

We prepare discharge paperwork based on the maternal vitals. To instruct on home care we need the result of the step where we prepare discharge paperwork.

Provide postpartum care needs the maternal vitals. To monitor labor progress, John uses the tocometer. First we provide postpartum care, then we instruct on home care.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Peter,

Here's roughly how the church parish office side works.

When we pay expenses we look at the financial ledger. John handles it when we need to create budget. To record donations, Mary uses the financial ledger. Mary is the one who tends to record donations. To create budget, Peter uses the financial ledger. And of course we create budget.

Susan is the one who tends to communicate with parishioners. We also schedule meetings. To communicate with parishioners, Mary uses the parishioner records. Half of this lives in people's heads.

When we schedule meetings we look at the parishioner records. We update records based on the parishioner records.

The financial ledger comes out of the step where we update records. The parishioner records pulls its numbers from the events calendar.

You can't promote events without the events calendar. When we organize service logistics we look at the events calendar.

Thanks,
Peter

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the concert promoter side works.

Bella handles it when we need to setup stage and equipment. Bella is the one who tends to setup stage and equipment. First we setup stage and equipment, then we manage on-site staff. We setup stage and equipment based on the event schedule. The ticket sale links comes out of the step where we manage on-site staff. The current roster pulls its numbers from the ticket sale links.

Venue contract is based on the event schedule. We might change some of this next year.

The current roster pulls its numbers from the social media ad. We setup stage and equipment based on the venue contract. When we launch promotional campaign we look at the social media ad. There's a current roster. Dana is in charge when we identify potential acts. We also identify potential acts. Someone needs to scout potential venues. You have to scout potential venues before you can negotiate venue terms. Negotiate venue terms needs the venue contract. There's also the venue contract.

Cheers,
Bella

Hi John,

Here's roughly how the police station custody suite side works.

To arrange legal contact, Lisa uses the legal phones. To arrange legal contact, Carlos uses the legal access log.

To intake new detainees, John uses the intake forms. We log detainee movements based on the holding cells. To prepare release paperwork, Lisa uses the release roster.

We always prepare release paperwork before we escort detainee out. The intake forms pulls its numbers from the holding cells. We only screen for health and safety concerns after we intake new detainees. You can't log detainee movements without the release roster. Lisa handles it when we need to intake new detainees. The release roster is what we go by when we arrange legal contact. It's Alex who gets to escort detainee out.

Cheers,
John

We only package wine orders after we sell wines to guests. You can't welcome guests without the guest register. We always lead vineyard tours before we pour wine samples. We also welcome guests. When we sell wines to guests we look at the wine inventory list.

Cheers,
Chris

Hello,

Here's roughly how the butcher shop side works.

Butchery — cut meat needs the cut list. To serve customers, Mike uses the cash register. We only record sales after we serve customers. Someone needs to record sales. It's David who gets to serve customers.

For inventory, David is in charge when we count stock daily. We only count stock daily after we serve customers.

New people always get confused by this.

Tom checks the meat display before they cut meat. For display, you can't rotate inventory without the meat display. Prepare display needs the meat display. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. And of course we receive deliveries.

Sarah looks after the supplier list. We only receive deliveries after we order meat supplies. Order meat supplies needs the supplier list.

Thanks,
Sarah

The coffee machine is broken again. The maintenance schedule is what we go by when we conduct safety checks.

John checks the maintenance schedule before they carry out repairs.

To record donations, Peter uses the financial ledger. The coffee machine is broken again. It's Mary who gets to pay expenses.

Create budget needs the financial ledger.

When we pay expenses we look at the financial ledger. Someone needs to record donations.

John

Cheers,
Emily

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the hospital ward side works.

For medical, someone needs to prescribe drugs. You have to do the ward round before you can prescribe drugs. We take observations based on the obs chart. You can't give medicines without the medication chart. The medication chart is Ruth's job. For discharge, Dr Mensah handles it when we need to plan discharge.

The plan discharge has to be sorted before the discharge letter. When we do the ward round we look at the obs chart. Half of this lives in people's heads. Prescribe drugs needs the medication chart.

The discharge letter pulls its numbers from the medication chart. The bed board is what we go by when we plan discharge. To admit patients, Ruth uses the bed board. Sister Ward is the one who tends to admit patients.

Best,
Ruth

Here's roughly how the recycling centre side works.

On the distribution side: Mia looks after the order list. To pack materials, Olivia uses the order list. The storage racks is what we go by when we store materials.

When we track inventory levels we look at the storage racks. We inspect materials based on the defect log.

You have to inspect materials before you can approve for storage. Mia handles it when we need to approve for storage.

The order list is filled in when we track inventory levels.

To approve for storage we need the result of the step where we store materials. To track inventory levels we need the result of the step where we pack materials. Carlos owns the delivery schedule. There's also the delivery schedule. Sort waste into categories comes after: check waste quality. There's also the processing bins.

Best,
Linda

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the mobile app release team side works.

Someone needs to prioritize tasks. You can't perform manual QA without the test plan. We always run continuous integration before we perform manual QA.

You have to sign the app before you can deploy to app store.

First we perform manual QA, then we build app binary. When we prioritize tasks we look at the product roadmap. The release changelog pulls its numbers from the product roadmap. Monitor user feedback comes after: deploy to app store.

Mike checks the product backlog before they prioritize tasks. To monitor user feedback, Sam uses the rollback plan.

We only sign the app after we build app binary.

Best,
Mike

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the phone repair kiosk side works.

First we diagnose phone issues, then we identify required parts.

To identify required parts, Ethan uses the replacement parts list.

Half of this lives in people's heads. We always process payment before we generate invoice.

Generate invoice needs the receipt. Dana is in charge when we process payment. We replace damaged components based on the repair tools. 'register customer information' comes before 'appointment queue'. Not sure this is all of it but here goes. Dana is in charge when we register customer information. We assess phone damage based on the appointment queue. The replacement parts list gets updated whenever we replace damaged components.

The parts inventory is built from the repair tools. The repair tools is built from the parts inventory. Process payment needs input from: register customer information.

The appointment queue gets updated whenever we diagnose phone issues. Prats inventory is based on the replacement parts list.

Dana checks the parts inventory before they update inventory levels. When we order new parts we look at the parts inventory.

Cheers,
Beth

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the warehouse fulfilment side works.

The bin locations is what we go by when we pick items. We pick items based on the pick list. Put stock away needs the bin locations. Plan pick waves needs the inventory system. The carrier manifest gets updated whenever we print shipping labels. The pick list is Lena's job.

We always print shipping labels before we hand over to the carrier. When we plan pick waves we look at the pick list.

When we put stock away we look at the inventory system. When we run cycle counts we look at the inventory system. Dev looks after the inventory system. Dispatch — Marta checks the carrier manifest before they hand over to the carrier.

Cheers,
Kofi

Hello,

Here's roughly how the cycling club side works.

When we invite members to events we look at the social agenda. When we organize social events we look at the social agenda.

'event calendar' comes before 'track rider progress'. Liam owns the training schedule.

We also track rider progress.

On the sponsorship side: the negotiate sponsorship deals has to be sorted before the sponsorship budget.

For training, Max handles it when we need to track rider progress. Re events: there's a event calendar. Half of this lives in people's heads. You can't recruit riders for events without the event calendar.

We lead training rides based on the training schedule. 'sponsorship budget' comes before 'social agenda'. We always lead training rides before we track rider progress.

We might change some of this next year.

Best,
Noah

Kevin

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the minicab dispatch side works.

'handle support requests' comes before 'issue log'. The issue log is what we go by when we resolve issues. The track driver progress has to be sorted before the ride status updates.

To track driver progress, Chris uses the driver location updates.

You have to compile daily reports before you can present reports. The operational data is what we go by when we compile daily reports. And of course we confirm bookings. The ride status updates is built from the operational data.

Parking is a nightmare btw. You can't handle support requests without the operational data.

Thanks,
Bella

Hi Zoe,

Here's roughly how the dog grooming salon side works.

We only dry the dog after we wash the dog.

First we dry the dog, then we trim hair. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. You can't trim hair without the grooming tools. Disinfect equipment needs the grooming equipment. The grooming equipment is Jake's job. The grooming equipment is what we go by when we clean the salon. On the aftercare side: Jake is in charge when we handover the dog to the client. (remind me to fix the printer). We only advise on aftercare after we handover the dog to the client. First we trim hair, then we handover the dog to the client. How we trim hair depends on how we disinfect equipment. Clean the salon comes after: handover the dog to the client.

Cheers,
Sam

Here's roughly how the landscaping company side works.

The design plan is built from the site layout plan.

Liam looks after the installation checklist. The project blueprint is what we go by when we estimate project costs. Liam checks the supplier list before they order materials and plants. And of course we order materials and plants.

We receive deliveries based on the installation checklist. The materials list is filled in when we order materials and plants.

On the planning side: 'estimate project costs' comes before 'project schedule'.

The project schedule draws on the installation checklist.

Emma

Hi Martin,

Here's roughly how the sheep farm side works.

The breeding roster is filled in when we distribute feed to pens. Administer vaccines needs the breeding roster. Laura is the one who tends to treat sick animals. We inspect pasture quality based on the grazing pastures.

We always artificial insemination before we shear sheep.

Artificial insemination needs the breeding roster. When we sort wool by quality we look at the wool bales. The feed types is what we go by when we mix feed batches. New people always get confused by this. To distribute feed to pens we need the result of the step where we rotate pastures. When we shear sheep we look at the wool bales. Sorry this is a bit all over the place. We always inspect pasture quality before we mix feed batches.

We distribute feed to pens based on the feed types.

Tom checks the grazing pastures before they rotate pastures. You have to treat sick animals before you can administer vaccines.

Tom handles it when we need to shear sheep.

Sam owns the breeding roster.

Best,
Tom

The assembled component is filled in when we package components.

Cheers,
Charlie

Hi Tom,

Here's roughly how the steel fabrication shop side works.

Fit parts together needs the assembled product. We check for alignment based on the assembled product. First we fit parts together, then we check for alignment. Lisa handles it when we need to check for alignment. When we weld parts together we look at the finished parts. Assembled product has moved between assembly and cutting twice this year and it's still argued about. The detailed blueprint is built from the shaped parts. The assembled product draws on the raw steel stock. The finished parts gets updated whenever we fit parts together. The detailed blueprint is built from the raw steel stock. Shaped parts is based on the finished parts. We also final inspection. To polish surfaces, Lisa uses the finished parts.

The finished parts is what we go by when we final inspection. Final inspection comes after: polish surfaces.

We always bend steel before we weld parts together. You can't weld parts together without the shaped parts. Bend steel needs the shaped parts. To cut to dimensions we need the result of the step where we measure cuts.

Cut to dimensions needs the raw steel stock.

When we model parts in CAD we look at the detailed blueprint.

There's also the detailed blueprint. The detailed blueprint is Jack's job.

Cheers,
Tom

Hannah

Here's roughly how the medical device manufacturer side works.

The technical specifications pulls its numbers from the assembly instructions. There's also the compliance documentation. The quality control report is built from the quality inspection report. Andrew looks after the technical specifications.

When we plan product launch we look at the compliance documentation. The coffee machine is broken again. There's a regulatory submission. When we plan product launch we look at the marketing campaign plan.

Carlos checks the assembly instructions before they assemble device. The compliance documentation is Rafael's job.

The assemble device has to be sorted before the quality inspection report. To plan product launch, Elena uses the marketing brochure. To refine design based on feedback, Elena uses the technical specifications. Compliance documentation is based on the regulatory submission. The draft initial design has to be sorted before the technical specifications. It's Lisa who gets to refine design based on feedback.

Best,
Rafael

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the refugee resettlement charity side works.

Apply for legal documents needs the employment resume. We only apply for legal documents after we consult with lawyer.

The legal counsel is Mark's job.

The coffee machine is broken again.

There's also the legal counsel.

Emma is the one who tends to provide job training. When we prepare living space we look at the housing lease. You have to inspect living space before you can prepare living space.

This has grown over the years. You can't consult with lawyer without the legal counsel.

Best,
Lisa

Hi Carla,

Here's roughly how the athletics club side works.

We check medical readiness based on the injury log.

We keep a injury log. The injury log is Ben's job.

To treat injuries, Alex uses the injury log. Conduct training sessions relies on whoever does the job to check medical readiness.

When we register new members we look at the training schedule. Conduct training sessions comes after: treat injuries. Conduct training sessions has moved between training and health twice this year and it's still argued about. Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

Conduct training sessions comes after: plan training sessions. The training schedule is what we go by when we conduct training sessions. Ben is in charge when we plan training sessions.

And of course we update member information. To register new members, Alex uses the member roster. There's a member roster. Mia checks the member roster before they update member information.

Parking is a nightmare btw.

Cheers,
Carla

Hi Mike,

Here's roughly how the steel fabrication shop side works.

We only add dimensions after we model parts in CAD. We weld parts together based on the shaped parts. Half of this lives in people's heads.

There's a assembled product. First we bend steel, then we weld parts together. To fit parts together, Mike uses the assembled product. We only final inspection after we polish surfaces. Check for alignment comes after: fit parts together. We might change some of this next year.

To check for alignment, Tom uses the assembled product.

Sarah handles it when we need to model parts in CAD.

Bend steel needs the shaped parts. Cut to dimensions relies on whoever does the job to measure cuts.

Cheers,
Lisa

Hello,

Here's roughly how the charity shop side works.

There's a cleaning schedule. Prepare items for display needs the cleaning schedule.

We always clean items before we prepare items for display. We also prepare items for display.

Prepare items for display relies on whoever does the job to assist customers. To set price, Michael uses the sales register.

When we process sales we look at the cleaning schedule. We process saels based on the sales register.

Assist customers needs the sales register. Sarah checks the inventory list before they check stock condition. Emma is in charge when we check stock condition.

The pricing guide is what we go by when we set price.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the scrap metal yard side works.

How we log scrap details depends on how we cut scrap. We cut scrap based on the cutting machine. When we bale scrap we look at the baling machine. You have to evaluate sales bids before you can arrange sale. To evaluate sales bids, Tom uses the sales bids. We log scrap details based on the scrap manifest.

It's Tom who gets to cut scrap. Receiving — someone needs to log scrap details. To arrange sale we need the result of the step where we deliver scrap.

First we inspect scrap quality, then we log scrap details. It mostly works, honestly. To log scrap details we need the result of the step where we bale scrap. Sort scrap relies on whoever does the job to cut scrap.

John owns the category bins. The category bins is what we go by when we weigh sorted scrap. The scrap manifest draws on the category bins. I'll tidy this up later. For sorting, we always sort scrap before we weigh sorted scrap. There's a transport trucks.

Cheers,
John

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the minicab dispatch side works.

The operational data is what we go by when we compile daily reports. How we notify drivers of bokoings depends on how we track driver progress.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense.

First we assign drivers to bookings, then we notify drivers of bookings. Present reports comes after: compile daily reports. Resolve issues needs the issue log.

The track driver progress has to be sorted before the ride status updates. When we confirm bookings we look at the booking log. 'receive booking requests' comes before 'booking log'.

Bella is the one who tends to confirm bookings. Confirm bookings relies on whoever does the job to assign drivers to bookings.

The ride status updates is built from the operational data.

To resolve issues, Chris uses the booking log. The driver availability list is what we go by when we assign drivers to bookings.

Best,
Bella

Hi Brian,

Here's roughly how the scaffolding firm side works.

We provide cost estimates based on the material list.

This has grown over the years.

When we record job details we look at the work logs. Maria checks the work logs before they dismantle scaffolding. We provide cost estimates based on the job plan. We keep a inspection checklist. The inspection report draws on the job plan. Dismantle scaffolding comes after: approve the scaffold setup. We only store dismantled materials after we dismantle scaffolding.

We keep a job plan. And of course we install safety components.

Thanks,
Brian

Carlos

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the office cleaning contractor side works.

To train staff on cleaning procedures we need the result of the step where we perform cleaning tasks. We always perform cleaning tasks before we inspect areas after cleaning. We only train staff on cleaning procedures after we recruit new staff. The order supplies has to be sorted before the supply inventory. Someone needs to plan daily tasks.

We always order supplies before we perform cleaning tasks.

To train staff on cleaning procedures, Lucy uses the staff roster.

Mike checks the supply inventory before they distribute supplies to staff.

John looks after the cleaning schedule.

Cheers,
John

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the arable farm side works.

We also plow the fields. Emily owns the maintenance tools. You can't inspect facilities without the maintenance tools.

You can't monitor water levels without the irrigation system. We water the fields based on the irrigation system. The farming equipment is built from the maintenance tools. To plant seeds we need the result of the step where we water the fields. Mike looks after the market demands. We only transport to market after we harvest crops.

Mike is in charge when we repair equipment. You have to water the fields before you can harvest crops.

The farming equipment is what we go by when we plant seeds. We only plant seeds after we plow the fields.

To repair equipment, Linda uses the maintenance tools.

Thanks,
Emily

On the assessment side: the evaluate student performance has to be sorted before the feedback notes.

Evaluate student performance has moved between assessment and communication twice this year and it's still argued about. Reschedule lessons needs the lesson plan. The lesson plan is what we go by when we book new lessons.

Instruction — the lesson materials is what we go by when we deliver lesson content. You can't deliver lesson content without the lesson plan. And of course we deliver lesson content.

We send lesson updates based on the communication log.

Cheers,
Sophia

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the school trip organising side works.

It's Lisa who gets to train staff on emergency procedures.

We also train staff on emergency procedures. We conduct activities based on the scheduled activities. Someone needs to supervise participants. When we supervise participants we look at the scheduled activities. Lisa is the one who tends to arrange transportation. Arrange transportation needs the transportation arrangements. You can't book accommodations without the transportation arrangements. 'notify parents and students' comes before 'update sheets'.

Lisa checks the update sheets before they track participant attendance.

It's Tom who gets to track participant attendance. Sarah is the one who tends to track participant attendance. Someone needs to notify parents and students. To set daily schedules, Sarah uses the trip itinerary.

We set daily schedules based on the budget plan.

We also set daily schedules. The risk assessment comes out of the step where we notify parents and students. You can't book accommodations without the budget plan. How we set daily schedules depends on how we conduct activities.

Supervise participants relies on whoever does the job to track participant attendance. Trip itinerary is based on the transportation arrangements.

Cheers,
Sarah

We organize fitness training based on the health records.

Thanks,
Casey

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the dairy farm side works.

It's Siân who gets to clean the parlour. You can't milk the cows without the milk yield log.

We only clean the parlour after we milk the cows.

Nia checks the herd records before they milk the cows.

The feed ration plan draws on the herd records. Honestly nobody agrees whether 'feed ration plan' is a feed thing or a milking thing. The feed ration plan pulls its numbers from the milk yield log.

Gareth is the one who tends to make silage. When we buy concentrate feed we look at the feed ration plan. When we arrange vet visits we look at the herd records.

Someone needs to arrange vet visits. Gareth owns the herd records.

Cheers,
Siân

Hi Pete,

Here's roughly how the public library side works.

Jun is the one who tends to order books from the vendor. When we catalogue new items we look at the library catalogue. The library catalogue is what we go by when we process returns.

You have to catalogue new items before you can label and cover books. We also label and cover books. New people always get confused by this. Catalogue new items comes after: order books from the vendor.

Jun is the one who tends to process returns. We always select new titles before we order books from the vendor. The library catalogue is what we go by when we lend items.

We keep a events calendar.

Best,
Ella

You can't update member information without the member roster.

We talked about this at the last meeting too.

Thanks,
Tom
