Hello,

Here's roughly how the village fete side works.

When we assign roles and responsibilities we look at the event budget. How we assign roles and responsibilities depends on how we organize performances.

The food setup draws on the registration desk. The donation collection is built from the supply inventory.

To organize performances, Lisa uses the food setup.

To assign roles and responsibilities we need the result of the step where we prepare food.

Kate owns the donation collection. We keep a raffle tickets. On the entertainment side: organize performances needs the game booths. Re food: Mark owns the food setup.

We also prepare food. Prepare food needs the food setup. You can't prepare food without the food menu.

Best,
Kate

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the freight forwarder side works.

We only create shipping documents after we schedule pickup. You can't notify client of status without the booking form.

Adjust pricing based on negotiation comes after: provide a quote. The pricing list pulls its numbers from the shipping documents. We create shipping documents based on the tracking status. File shipping documents with customs comes after: create shipping documents. There's a pricing list. Schedule pickup comes after: confirm shipping details. We always update tracking status before we notify client of status. Alex checks the pricing list before they provide a quote. The pricing list is Priya's job.

To confirm shipping details we need the result of the step where we provide a quote. Someone needs to notify client of status.

Best,
Raj

Hi Linda,

Here's roughly how the maternity unit side works.

Facilitate mother-newborn bonding needs input from: provide postpartum care.

Michael is the one who tends to provide postpartum care. We only instruct on home care after we provide postpartum care. We always assist in labor before we deliver baby. First we evaluate newborn health, then we facilitate mother-newborn bonding.

Register patient needs input from: provide postpartum care. We register patient based on the patient records. And of course we register patient. The tocometer is what we go by when we monitor labor progress.

How we assist in labor depends on how we monitor labor progress. Instruct on home care needs input from: prepare discharge paperwork. Sarah looks after the delivery instruments. Half of this lives in people's heads.

It's Michael who gets to deliver baby. When we deliver baby we look at the delivery instruments. The coffee machine is broken again. To evaluate newborn health we need the result of the step where we deliver baby.

Thanks,
Linda

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the car repair garage side works.

We talked about this at the last meeting too. I'll tidy this up later.

The workshop diary is what we go by when we book cars in.

We order parts based on the parts price list. To inspect the car, Ravi uses the job card. It's Sandra who gets to run diagnostics. The job card is what we go by when we run diagnostics.

The job card is what we go by when we write the invoice. Jo checks the job card before they order parts. When we carry out repairs we look at the job card. When we write the invoice we look at the parts price list. We only inspect the car after we book cars in.

Sandra checks the parts shelf before they carry out repairs.

You have to write the invoice before you can take payment on collection.

Ravi handles it when we need to take payment on collection.

Thanks,
Mick

Here's roughly how the architecture practice side works.

You have to deploy to production before you can monitor post-deployment performance. We only specify implementation details after we validate against design. Lucas checks the use case descriptions before they refine requirements.

How we deploy to production depends on how we apply patches and fixes. You can't specify implementation details without the implementation guidelines. Perform integration tests relies on whoever does the job to deploy to production. Half of this lives in people's heads. New people always get confused by this. Perform integration tests comes after: perform unit tests. Evolve architecture as needed needs the update logs.

Someone needs to monitor post-deployment performance. To apply patches and fixes, Emily uses the implementation guidelines. There's a rolblack plan.

We only refine requirements after we gather stakeholder inputs. Specify implementation details relies on whoever does the job to perform unit tests.

The rollback plan is what we go by when we monitor post-deployment performance. Sarah handles it when we need to gather stakeholder inputs.

To apply patches and fixes, Emily uses the update logs.

Sarah owns the use case descriptions.

Cheers,
Lucas

Hi Carla,

Here's roughly how the athletics club side works.

Alex is the one who tends to organize events. We check medical readiness based on the injury log. On the events side: you can't organize events without the event plan.

You have to treat injuries before you can conduct training sessions.

Conduct training sessions needs input from: check medical readiness.

We only conduct training sessions after we plan training sessions.

For health, Alex checks the injury log before they treat injuries. Mia is in charge when we organize events.

Thanks,
Alex

Hello,

Here's roughly how the air traffic control tower side works.

To schedule takeoffs and landings, Tom uses the flight plan list. We always communicate with pilots and ground staff before we schedule takeoffs and landings.

Mei checks the safety checklist before they verify aircraft adherence to rules.

Ben looks after the safety checklist. First we alert in case of emergency, then we verify aircraft adherence to rules.

'track aircraft movements' comes before 'flight log'. We track aircraft movements based on the radar display. How we schedule takeoffs and landings depends on how we track aircraft movements. To communicate with pilots and ground staff we need the result of the step where we transmit instructions to aircraft.

Provide navigational guidance relies on whoever does the job to transmit instructions to aircraft. We only provide navigational guidance after we alert in case of emergency. You have to track aircraft movements before you can verify aircraft adherence to rules.

To update aircraft on position we need the result of the step where we receive messages from aircraft.

Best,
Priya

To check delivery quality, Ana uses the inventory list. We always place food orders before we check delivery quality.

(remind me to fix the printer). The serving trays is what we go by when we clean dining tables. You can't cook dishes according to menu without the inventory list.

Cheers,
Raj

Lisa

Here's roughly how the month-end close side works.

We run payroll based on the timesheets.

Lars checks the general ledger before they run payroll.

Run the payment run needs the general ledger. The budget variance report pulls its numbers from the aged debtors.

We post accruals based on the general ledger. Ahmed checks the general ledger before they reconcile the bank.

There's a budget variance report. Tess is the one who tends to run the payment run. We always enter supplier invoices before we run the payment run.

To run the payment run, Lars uses the aged creditors. Chase overdue invoices needs the aged debtors.

Thanks,
Ahmed

Hi Olivia,

Here's roughly how the fishmonger side works.

For sourcing, there's a supplier list. The supplier list is Ethan's job. On the preparation side: Liam is in charge when we cut fish. And of course we cut fish. First we clean fish, then we cut fish. Cut fish needs the cut types. There's also the cut types.

You can't service customers without the customer list.

Ethan checks the customer list before they sell fish.

Someone needs to store fish. To check freshness, Ethan uses the inventory log. When we store fish we look at the inventory log. We always inspect quality before we check freshness. This has grown over the years. First we cut fish, then we sell fish. The inventory log gets updated whenever we clean fish.

Best,
Olivia

Hi Lisa,

Here's roughly how the photography studio side works.

To take photos we need the result of the step where we edit photos. Finalize client selection relies on whoever does the job to back up photos to drive.

Upload to cloud storage needs the cloud storage. We review and refine edits based on the editing software. The booking calendar is what we go by when we schedule photo sessions. Upload to cloud storage comes after: edit photos. The booking calendar comes out of the step where we present the portfolio to client.

People disagree about who owns 'edit photos': some say editing, some say storage. Schedule photo sessions relies on whoever does the job to set up the shoot location. This has grown over the years. Hello,

Here's roughly how the bus manufacturer side works.

There's also the list of sales leads. The design schematics draws on the list of required parts. We always create 3D models before we write technical specifications. We perform quality inspections based on the quality checklist. We only make necessary adjustments after we conduct demonstrations.

Write technical specifications needs the prototype bus.

Emma is in charge when we conduct demonstrations. We perform initial tests based on the prototype bus. First we perform initial tests, then we assemble the bus.

Final bus inspection needs input from: assemble the bus.

For engineering, you have to build the prototype before you can perform initial tests. Make necessary adjustments needs input from: perform quality inspections.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. John owns the quality checklist.

You can't write technical specifications without the design schematics. When we assemble the bus we look at the list of required parts.

Thanks,
Ava

Hi Dr Patel,

Here's roughly how the dental clinic side works.

The coffee machine is broken again. We only carry out treatment after we examine the patient.

Owen checks the patient notes before they submit insurance claims. Grace checks the patient notes before they examine the patient.

Owen checks the treatment plan before they invoice the patient. We always clean instruments before we run the autoclave. The treatment plan pulls its numbers from the patient notes. The consent forms is what we go by when we carry out treatment. You can't update medical history without the patient notes. Examine the patient comes after: check patients in. To check patients in, Fatima uses the appointment diary. The appointment diary is what we go by when we book appointments. Dr Patel is the one who tends to submit insurance claims. We carry out treatment based on the treatment plan.

Best,
Grace

item.input:
Hi Nora,

Here's roughly how the debt collection agency side works.

Mike looks after the assignment criteria.

You can't assign cases to collectors without the assignment criteria. Nora checks the case file before they update case file. The case file is what we go by when we log communications.

We only compile recovery data after we file lawsuit. Assign cases to collectors relies on whoever does the job to contact debtors. To negotiate terms we need the result of the step where we update case file. Analyze performance comes after: contact debtors.

Update case file relies on whoever does the job to compile recovery data.

We only log communications after we negotiate terms. Prepare legal documentation relies on whoever does the job to negotiate terms. Mike checks the payment plan before they contact debtors. There's a payment plan.

To negotiate terms, Sam uses the payment plan. We also prepare legal documentation.

You can't prepare legal documentation without the legal case filing.

We talked about this at the last meeting too.

You can't file lawsuit without the legal case filing. It's Sam who gets to prepare legal documentation. Parking is a nightmare btw. The performance report is what we go by when we analyze performance. Lisa is in charge when we analyze performance. When we compile recovery data we look at the performance report.

Cheers,
Lisa

Hi Michael,

Here's roughly how the adult education centre side works.

Someone needs to create course materials. You can't create course materials without the course syllabus. We always manage classroom resources before we assign seats. David checks the class schedule before they manage classroom resources. You have to teach the course content before you can interact with students.

When we teach the course content we look at the lesson plan. The class schedule is what we go by when we promote the courses.

We always assign seats before we teach the course content. We create course materials based on the course brochure. Course syllabus is based on the lesson plan. It mostly works, honestly.

We promote the courses based on the course brochure. First we promote the courses, then we enrol students. And of course we provide feedback. There's also the assessment rubric.

Cheers,
Linda

You can't sort donations without the donation log. To check stock condition, Sarah uses the inventory list. The pricing guide is what we go by when we set price. We only set price after we assess item condition.

Best,
Emma

Hi Ryan,

Here's roughly how the dance school side works.

Leo checks the demonstration video before they teach dance moves. We correct student's technique based on the demonstration video.

For curriculum, when we schedule classes we look at the dance syllabus. There's also the performance calendar. Rehearse performance needs the performance calendar. Rehearse performance needs the costume list. Re evaluation: to evaluate student performance, Emma uses the feedback report. You can't enroll new students without the class roster. There's a class roster. To enroll new students, Ryan uses the payment records.

The performance calendar gets updated whenever we enroll new students. How we schedule classes depends on how we teach dance moves.

The class roster comes out of the step where we evaluate student performance.

New people always get confused by this.

Cheers,
Mia

Hello,

Here's roughly how the phone repair kiosk side works.

We repair software issues based on the repair tools. We always diagnose phone issues before we identify required parts. You can't replace damaged components without the repair tools. The register customer information has to be sorted before the appointment queue.

The repair tools is Dana's job. When we order new parts we look at the parts inventory. Parking is a nightmare btw. The appointment queue is filled in when we diagnose phone issues. Update inventory levels needs the parts inventory. The parts inventory draws on the repair tools.

There's also the receipt. We talked about this at the last meeting too. To process payment we need the result of the step where we register customer information. The repair tools pulls its numbers from the parts inventory.

Best,
Beth

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the school library side works.

To place books on shelves, Emma uses the checkout records.

Accept book returns relies on whoever does the job to place books on shelves. Place orders with suppliers relies on whoever does the job to scan book barcodes. Accept book returns needs the checkout records.

Emma is the one who tends to accept book returns.

Half of this lives in people's heads. We also sort books by category. It's Emma who gets to scan book barcodes. You can't scan book barcodes without the library database.

Place orders with suppliers relies on whoever does the job to place orders with suppliers. How we select new books depends on how we place orders with suppliers.

We inspect books for damage based on the maintenance inventory. It mostly works, honestly.

Thanks,
Olivia

Calculate total cost relies on whoever does the job to confirm booking details.

To conduct pre-flight inspection, Jamie uses the maintenance checklist. Sam is in charge when we charge the client. To calculate total cost, Casey uses the billing invoice.

Thanks,
Alex

item.input:
Hi Dana,

Here's roughly how the aquarium side works.

When we treat sick fish we look at the health logs. Dana is in charge when we treat sick fish. Tag new arrivals comes after: treat sick fish. Dana checks the fish inventory before they count the fish. We always feed the fish before we observe feeding behavior. Feed the fish needs the feeding schedule. You can't count the fish without the health logs.

We visually inspect fish based on the health logs. You have to observe feeding behavior before you can visually inspect fish.

We might change some of this next year. Bob handles it when we need to visually inspect fish.

It mostly works, honestly.

First we clean aquarium and equipment, then we inspect equipment. When we tag new arrivals we look at the fish inventory.

Bob is the one who tends to observe feeding behavior.

Cheers,
Bob

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the architecture practice side works.

When we perform integration tests we look at the test cases.

Perform integration tests comes after: perform unit tests.

Evolve architecture as needed needs the update logs. Lucas checks the update logs before they apply patches and fixes.

And of course we draft initial designs.

First we draft initial designs, then we review and refine designs. It's Lucas who gets to draft iintial designs. We always deploy to production before we monitor post-deployment performance. When we refine requirements we look at the use case descriptions. You have to gather stakeholder inputs before you can refine requirements.

To gather stakeholder inputs we need the result of the step where we draft initial designs. How we deploy to production depends on how we apply patches and fixes. Perform integration tests relies on whoever does the job to deploy to production. How we refine requirements depends on how we review and refine designs. We talked about this at the last meeting too.

Cheers,
Lucas

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the cake decorating business side works.

Lisa handles it when we need to conduct taste tsets. When we order ingredients and materials we look at the supplier list. You have to decorate the cake before you can inspect the cake for quality.

We always order ingredients and materials before we receive deliveries. We conduct taste tests based on the quality checklist. Sam looks after the design template. And of course we sketch design ideas. And of course we inspect the cake for quality.

For production, we decorate the cake based on the production recipe. First we bake the cake, then we decorate the cake. Re design: when we sketch design ideas we look at the color palette.

You can't receive deliveries without the quality checklist. Order ingredients and materials needs the production recipe. The design template draws on the production recipe. The design template is what we go by when we sketch design ideas. You can't inspect the cake for quality without the quality checklist.

Best,
Lisa

Hello,

Here's roughly how the language school side works.

Re teaching: you can't deliver language lessons without the student workbook. There's also the lesson plan. When we deliver language lessons we look at the lesson plan. There's also the student workbook. To administer language tests, Ava uses the student gradebook.

Emma checks the student gradebook before they provide feedback. To provide tutoring sessions, Noah uses the learning resources. And of course we provide tutoring sessions. First we provide tutoring sessions, then we offer academic counseling. We only administer language tests after we deliver language lessons. The teaching materials draws on the student workbook.

The learning resources draws on the student workbook. Provide tutoring sessions comes after: deliver language lessons. To provide feedback we need the result of the step where we offer academic counseling. We review course content based on the teaching materials. Noah is the one who tends to review course content.

Student recruitment — we always promote on social media before we conduct interviews.

To conduct interviews, Noah uses the student recruitment brochure. And of course we promote on social media.

Cheers,
Liam

Cheers,
Martin

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the homeless shelter side works.

You have to conduct initial assessment before you can register individuals. Connect residents to resources needs the community resource list. To organize events, Saarh uses the community resource list. We always provide check-ups before we provide case management. To register individuals we need the result of the step where we assign shelter space.

Conduct life skills training needs input from: connect residents to resources. The shelter list is what we go by when we inspect shelters.

'community resource list' comes before 'individual support plan'.

Half of this lives in people's heads. On the community side: and of course we connect residents to resources. We assign shelter space based on the shelter list. You can't provide case management without the individual support plan. We always conduct life skills training before we provide case management. The medication list is what we go by when we provide check-ups. And of course we assign shelter space. Someone needs to conduct life skills training. We always inspect shelters before we provide check-ups.

Best,
John

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the picture framing shop side works.

Measure the artwork comes after: client approves the design. We only cut the frame and matting materials after we measure the artwork. When we cut the frame and matting materials we look at the cutting tools. Jake handles it when we need to measure the artwork. Emily handles it when we need to layout the frame design. We always layout the frame design before we client approves the design. The design sample is what we go by when we layout the frame design. We only wrap the finished piece after we polish the frame. Jake checks the final accessories before they wrap the finished piece.

We talked about this at the last meeting too.

Best,
Emily

Hi Aisha,

Here's roughly how the mosque community centre side works.

We inspect the facilities based on the event calendar. Monthly theme is based on the event flyer. Schedule events needs the educational curriculum. The event calendar is what we go by when we announce events on social media. The monthly theme is what we go by when we schedule events. Ali looks after the event calendar.

You can't schedule events without the event calendar.

You can't teach classes without the educational resource. Omar checks the educational curriculum before they teach classes. There's also the educational resource. We inspect the facilities based on the maintenance log. It's Fatima who gets to inspect the facilities.

Omar owns the maintenance log.

We inspect the facilities based on the maintenance checklist.

We also distribute flyers in the community. To announce events on social media, Ali uses the event flyer. We only distribute flyers in the community after we announce events on social media.

Best,
Ali

Hi Liam,

Here's roughly how the fishmonger side works.

We keep a supplier list.

Someone needs to source fish. It's Isabella who gets to source fish. The supplier list is what we go by when we source fish. Inspect quality comes after: source fish.

We always inspect quality before we check freshness. 'reconcile accounts' comes before 'supplier list'.

How we source fish depends on how we store fish. First we cut fish, then we sell fish.

Sell fish relies on whoever does the job to record sales. To cut fish, Liam uses the cut types. Liam handles it when we need to cut fish.

Iasbella checks the customer list before they service customers. To sell fish, Olivia uses the customer list. To record sales, Olivia uses the sales ledger. To reconcile accounts, Isabella uses the sales ledger. Re storage: and of course we store fish. You can't store fish without the inventory log.

You can't check freshness without the inventory log.

Cheers,
Ethan

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the coastguard station side works.

The 天气预报 is what we go by when we 报告天气. We keep a 天气预报.

Dave handles it when we need to 通知相关机构. 发出紧急警报 comes after: 监控雷达. To 报告天气 we need the result of the step where we 管理库存.

管理库存 needs the 物资清单. How we 发出紧急警报 depends on how we 通知相关机构. 记录船只活动 comes after: 监控雷达.

Dave checks the 物资清单 before they 维护设备. Emily is in charge when we 监控雷达.

Cheers,
Emily

Hi Nkechi,

Here's roughly how the online shop side works.

The take product photos has to be sorted before the product listings. We process refunds based on the returns log. The product listings is Bo's job.

Set prices needs the product listings. Lily checks the orders table before they process checkout. Process refunds needs the orders table.

There's also the returns log. Process checkout needs the product listings. Lily checks the product listings before they run ads. There's also the orders table.

It's Arjun who gets to set prices.

Arjun checks the discount codes before they run ads. We also process refunds. To process checkout, Nkechi uses the discount codes. Bo is the one who tends to take product photos.

And of course we answer customer emails.

Thanks,
Nkechi

To collect empty trays, Mei uses the serving trays. We also prepare food items. To place food orders, Ana uses the inventory list. How we sanitize kitchen equipment depends on how we cook dishes according to menu.

You can't clean dining tables without the serving trays. Raj checks the meal menu before they serve food to students. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. When we cook dishes according to menu we look at the inventory list.

Best,
Mei

Hello,

Here's roughly how the tea room side works.

How we serve tea depends on how we brew tea. We also serve tea. You can't brew tea without the tea menu. For inventory, you can't count inventory monthly without the inventory ledger.

Linda is in charge when we count inventory monthly. When we update stock levels we look at the inventory ledger. Linda checks the inventory ledger before they place orders. How we record transactions depends on how we updtae stock levels.

Update stock levels relies on whoever does the job to brew tea. To select tea varieties, Peter uses the tea menu. To record transactions we need the result of the step where we place orders.

For sourcing, place orders comes after: select tea varieties.

New people always get confused by this. Place orders needs the supplier contacts. Linda checks the accounting ledger before they generate financial reports. The record transactions has to be sorted before the accounting ledger.

Cheers,
John

Forming — you can't weld parts together without the shaped parts.

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the council planning enforcement side works.

The enforcement notice is what we go by when we issue notice. Investigate complaints needs the complaints log.

We only investigate complaints after we register complaints. Parking is a nightmare btw. We always register appeals before we review appeal. New people always get confused by this.

We always prepare for hearings before we prosecute cases.

We prosecute cases based on the legal case. When we prosecute cases we look at the enforcement notice. Issue notice comes after: document findings. Issue notice comes after: investigate complaints. To register complaints we need the result of the step where we visit site. Issue notice comes after: prepare for hearings.

We only document findings after we visit site. The inspection report is what we go by when we document findings.

It's Alice who gets to document findings. There's also the inspection report.

Thanks,
Alice

Jordan

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the fireworks display side works.

'required permits' comes before 'display schedule'. There's a safety equipment.

There's also the launch sites. Raj owns the launch sites. You can't layout the sites without the safety perimeters. The safety protocols is filled in when we time the cues. We layout the sites based on the launch sites. Clear the site comes after: time the cues. New people always get confused by this. We also check deliveries.

The display schedule gets updated whenever we layout the sites. The launch sites comes out of the step where we fire the fireworks.

The safety protocols is what we go by when we monitor the perimeter.

The display schedule is filled in when we time the cues. Fire the fireworks comes after: time the cues.

Monitor the perimeter needs input from: time the cues.

There's also the required permits. We also collect debris. To design fireworks sequences, Lily uses the display schedule. New people always get confused by this. Lily handles it when we need to design fireworks sequences. To check deliveries we need the result of the step where we layout the sites.

Fire the fireworks needs the firing sequence. We also time the cues.

Cheers,
Mei

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the nightclub side works.

The security logs is what we go by when we patrol the premises. Manage VIP entry relies on whoever does the job to check ID and bags. When we serve drinks we look at the drink menu. Check ID and bags needs the security logs. You can't confirm bookings without the booking list.

We clean the bar based on the drink menu. You can't program the lights without the lighting design.

Casey is the one who tends to mix the music. Serve drinks relies on whoever does the job to mix the music. It's Sam who gets to patrol the premises. And of course we check ID and bags.

We adjust the levels based on the sound setup. To confirm bookings we need the result of the step where we check ID and bags. When we manage VIP entry we look at the booking list. The coffee machine is broken again. Mix the music needs the sound setup. Program the lights comes after: mix the music. Parking is a nightmare btw. We keep a booking list.

Best,
Taylor

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the steel fabrication shop side works.

Shaped parts is based on the finished parts.

To weld parts together, Jack uses the finished parts. We also add dimensions. Lisa checks the shaped parts before they weld parts together. You have to bend steel before you can weld parts together. It's Jack who gets to weld parts together. Tom is the one who tends to bend steel.

When we bend steel we look at the shaped parts. You have to polish surfaces before you can final inspection. The finished parts is what we go by when we polish surfaces. Sarah checks the finished parts before they final inspection. Parking is a nightmare btw.

The coffee machine is broken again.

Cheers,
Mike

item.input:
Hi Lee,

Here's roughly how the property letting agency side works.

Amara checks the landlord statement before they send a contractor. People disagree about who owns 'landlord statement': some say rent, some say maintenance. When we collect rent we look at the tenancy agreement.

The tenancy agreement pulls its numbers from the property adverts.

The tenancy agreement pulls its numbers from the safety certificates. We run viewings based on the safety certificates. For tenancy, register the deposit needs the tenancy agreement. And of course we register the deposit. 'reference tenants' comes before 'tenancy agreement'. Someone needs to send a contractor. There's a repairs log. When we send a contractor we look at the repairs log. Someone needs to run viewings. 'do rental valuations' comes before 'property adverts'. The property adverts has to be sorted before the run viewings. First we collect rent, then we pay landlords. Amara checks the landlord statement before they pay landlords.

We book gas safety checks based on the safety certificates. The safety certificates is Hugo's job.

Thanks,
Hugo

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the petrol station side works.

When we set and reset the alarm we look at the seucrity cameras. When we patrol the station we look at the security cameras.

The set and reset the alarm has to be sorted before the cash register. How we dispense fuel depends on how we process card payments.

Maintain fuel pumps comes after: sweep the forecourt. How we check fuel levels depends on how we restock shelves.

Dispense fuel needs input from: handle cash transactions. First we process card payments, then we handle cash transactions.

Handle cash transactions needs the cash register. You can't dispense fuel without the fuel pumps. To maintain fuel pumps, Sam uses the fuel pumps. To restock shelves, Sam uses the store inventory.

Thanks,
Sam

To notify drivers of bookings we need the result of the step where we track driver progress.

Thanks,
Bella

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the security guard company side works.

We only respond to incidents after we respond to alarms. David checks the candidate profile before they conduct knowledge tests.

Conduct drills relies on whoever does the job to walk patrol routes. Watch live feeds needs the patrol schedule. The partol report draws on the incident report. Re patrol: Lisa is in charge when we walk patrol routes. To walk patrol routes, David uses the patrol report.

When we walk patrol routes we look at the patrol schedule. You can't watch live feeds without the monitoring log. You can't respond to alarms without the monitoring log.

You can't respond to incidents without the incident report. There's also the candidate profile. When we background screening we look at the candidate profile. When we conduct interviews we look at the candidate profile. We always conduct drills before we conduct knowledge tests.

The guard manual is what we go by when we conduct knowledge tests.

Thanks,
Mike

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the art gallery side works.

Conservation — we also document condition. Sam handles it when we need to document condition.

To document condition, Ava uses the conservation records. Leo checks the inventory list before they sell artworks. We always appraise artwork value before we sell artworks. You can't advertise exhibition without the social media posts. Advertise exhibition needs the exhibition brochure. Re events: the invite artists has to be sorted before the event schedule. We also invite artists. Emily checks the exhibition theme before they invite artists. We might change some of this next year. To appraise artwork value, Ava uses the artwork collection.

Leo checks the conservation records before they install artworks. The exhibition layout is built from the event schedule. To advertise exhibition, Emily uses the inventory list.

Curation — Ava owns the artwork collection. Parking is a nightmare btw. You can't choose artworks without the exhibition theme. We choose artworks based on the artwork collection. The exhibition layout is what we go by when we install artworks.

Cheers,
Olivia

How we assign cases to collectors depends on how we contact debtors. You have to contact debtors before you can analyze performance. Log communications needs the case file.

Sam owns the legal case fiilng. The payment plan is what we go by when we contact debtors.

Lisa owns the payment plan.

Thanks,
Sam

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the sailing club side works.

You have to teach sailing classes before you can brief members on safety. There's also the boat fleet.

The maintenance log is what we go by when we perform maintenance. To perform maintenance, Beth uses the boat fleet. Register new members needs the training schedule. 'book sailing slots' comes before 'boat fleet'.

When we inspect boats and equipment we look at the maintenance log. Renew membership needs the member roster. To register new members, Beth uses the member roster. It's Diana who gets to renew membership.

The training schedule is what we go by when we evaluate skill levels.

And of course we send out notifications. You can't teach sailing classes without the training schedule.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the sailing club side works.

You have to teach sailing classes before you can brief members on safety. There's also the boat fleet.

The maintenance log is what we go by when we perform maintenance. To perform maintenance, Beth uses the boat fleet. Register new members needs the training schedule. 'book sailing slots' comes before 'boat fleet'.

When we inspect boats and equipment we look at the maintenance log. Renew membership needs the member roster. To register new members, Beth uses the member roster. It's Diana who gets to renew membership.

The training schedule is what we go by when we evaluate skill levels.

And of course we send out notifications. You can't teach sailing classes without the training schedule.

Thanks,
Alex

Hello,

Here's roughly how the adult education centre side works.

And of course we interact with students. How we enrol students depends on how we assess student performance. Honestly nobody agrees whether 'class schedule' is a classroom management thing or a student recruitment thing. We create course materials based on the course brochure. Michael checks the class schedule before they promote the courses. The course syllabus is built from the lesson plan. We always manage classroom resources before we assign seats. To manage classroom resources, David uses the class schedule. On the assessment side: we also assess student performance. We only provide feedback after we assess student performance. I'll tidy this up later. To assess student performance, Emma uses the assessment rubric.

For student recruitment, you have to promote the courses before you can enrol students. Someone needs to promote the courses.

The course brochure is what we go by when we promote the courses.

The course syllabus is what we go by when we create course materials.

Thanks,
David

You can't finalize design without the client feedback. And of course we finalize design. To create 3D models, Ava uses the design sketch.

Choose furniture relies on whoever does the job to oversee installation.

You can't search for materials without the supplier catalog. Create 3D models needs the floor plan. Oversee installation needs the installation schedule. Supervise contractors needs input from: make adjustments. I'll tidy this up later.

Floor plan is based on the supplier catalog.

Thanks,
Olivia

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the petrol station side works.

We only maintain fuel pumps after we sweep the forecourt. Jack checks the maintenance tools before they sweep the forecourt. When we check fuel levels we look at the maintenance tools. There's also the maintenance tools. It's Sam who gets to check fuel levels. We set and reset the alarm based on the security cameras. Lisa checks the security cameras before they patrol the station. We also set and reset the alarm. We also dispense fuel.

We also maintain fuel pumps. New people always get confused by this.

To maintain fuel pumps, Sam uses the fuel pumps.

It's Sam who gets to dispense fuel. When we dispense fuel we look at the fuel pumps.

It mostly works, honestly.

Thanks,
Jack

Noah is in charge when we track rider progress.

First we lead training rides, then we track rider progress.

Olivia

Hello,

Here's roughly how the newsletter publishing side works.

We always commission articles before we edit articles. You can't lay out the issue without the email template.

The send the issue has to be sorted before the open-rate report.

Femi checks the email template before they send the issue.

Moe checks the mailing list before they send the issue.

Moe is the one who tends to send the issue. The mailing list is what we go by when we process unsubscribes. Femi checks the mailing list before they handle sign-ups. To commission articles, Moe uses the editorial calendar. First we edit articles, then we lay out the issue.

You have to lay out the issue before you can send the issue.

Cheers,
Kat

item.input:
Hello,

Here's roughly how the concert promoter side works.

The current roster pulls its numbers from the ticket sale links. On the booking side: when we negotiate contract terms we look at the current roster. You can't setup stage and equipment without the venue contract. Someone needs to set up ticketing system. Set up ticketing system needs the ticket sale links. The ticket sale links is filled in when we manage on-site staff. Current roster is based on the social media ad. We launch promotional campaign based on the social media ad. To launch promotional campaign we need the result of the step where we set up ticketing system. Negotiate contract terms comes after: identify potential acts. The venue contract is what we go by when we negotiate venue terms.

You have to set up ticketing system before you can track ticket sales.

Manage on-site staff comes after: setup stage and equipment. The venue contract pulls its numbers from the event schedule. Negotiate venue terms comes after: scout potential venues. Alex checks the ticket sale links before they launch promotional campaign.

You can't setup stage and equipment without the event schedule.

Best,
Carlos

Hello,

Here's roughly how the council planning enforcement side works.

We always prepare for hearings before we issue notice. First we prepare for hearings, then we prosecute cases. Bob is the one who tends to prosecute cases. Prosecute cases needs the legal case. You have to register appeals before you can review appeal. Document findings needs the inspection report.

The appeal record is what we go by when we review appeal. We only investigate complaints after we register complaints. Bob handles it when we need to visit site. We also review appeal.

We only document findings after we visit site. First we document findings, then we issue notice. We always follow up on compliance before we register appeals. How we register complaints depends on how we visit site.

You have to issue notice before you can follow up on compliance. We investigate complaints based on the complaints log.

You have to investigate complaints before you can issue notice.

Best,
Alice

Luis

Someone needs to check ingredient levels. To verify order details, Luis uses the order queue. Someone needs to cook meals. To check ingredient levels, Luis uses the inventory stock.

The order queue gets updated whenever we prepare ingredients. When we restock ingredients we look at the inventory stock.

Mia looks after the delivery list. To dispatch orders, Zoe uses the delivery list. Dispatch orders comes after: pack meals. Cook meals comes after: prepare ingredients. Prepare ingerdients needs input from: prepare ingredients.

How we check ingredient levels depends on how we prepare ingredients. It's Luis who gets to check ingredient levels.

Restock ingredients needs input from: prepare ingredients. Zoe is in charge when we restock ingredients.

Thanks,
Luis

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the maternity unit side works.

Honestly nobody agrees whether 'maternal vitals' is a postpartum thing or a discharge thing. You can't monitor labor progress without the tocometer. The maternal vitals is what we go by when we prepare discharge paperwork. We always assist in labor before we deliver baby.

We prepare discharge paperwork based on the discharge guidelines. Evaluate newborn health needs input from: deliver baby. You have to evaluate newborn health before you can facilitate mother-newborn bonding. The delivery instruments is what we go by when we deliver baby. It's Michael who gets to assist in labor. Assist in lbaor needs input from: monitor labor progress.

The maternal vitals is Sarah's job.

Cheers,
Emily

Hello,

Here's roughly how the online shop side works.

Re catalogue: the take product photos has to be sorted before the product listings.

Process refunds needs the returns log. When we answer customer emails we look at the tracking numbers.

You can't process refunds without the orders table. The orders table is what we go by when we pack orders. When we run ads we look at the product listings.

You can't run ads without the discount codes. To process checkout, Nkechi uses the product listings.

When we process checkout we look at the orders table. Nkechi looks after the orders table.

Bo is the one who tends to process checkout. Bo is the one who tends to answer customer emails.

Set prices needs the product listings. Fulfilment — first we pack orders, then we post parcels.

When we post parcels we look at the tracking numbers. We also pack orders. Process checkout needs the discount codes.

Thanks,
Lily

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the homeless shelter side works.

You have to provide therapy sessions before you can provide check-ups. Re housing: Sarah checks the shelter list before they assign shelter space.

We provide check-ups based on the medication list. You have to inspect shelters before you can provide check-ups. The coffee machine is broken again. First we provide check-ups, then we provide case management.

On the health side: and of course we provide check-ups.

Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

Sarah is the one who tends to inspect shelters. On the support side: to provide case management, John uses the individual support plan. Inspect shelters needs the shelter list.

Maria is in charge when we conduct life skills training. We only provide case management after we conduct life skills training.

Sarah is the one who tends to provide case management.

Provide case management comes after: provide therapy sessions.

Best,
John

The classify the incident type has to be sorted before the incident report. We always verify system integrity before we update security policies. The train staff on new procedures has to be sorted before the lessons learned document.

Lisa is the one who tends to update security policies. The isolate affected systems has to be sorted before the containment plan. It's David who gets to verify system integrity.

Cheers,
David

Hi Nkechi,

Here's roughly how the online shop side works.

On the catalogue side: 'take product photos' comes before 'product listings'. Re support: we also answer customer emails. On the orders side: we keep a orders table. We set prices based on the product listings.

Answer customer emails needs the tracking numbers. For marketing, Bo looks after the discount codes. We process refunds based on the orders table.

Re support: you can't process refunds without the returns log.

Half of this lives in people's heads. It's Lily who gets to pack orders. You have to pack orders before you can post parcels.

Arjun is the one who tends to pack orders. When we pack orders we look at the orders table. The orders table is Arjun's job. To post parcels, Arjun uses the tracking numbers.

Cheers,
Lily

Raj

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the synagogue events side works.

We keep a Torah readings. When we prepare for service we look at the blessings list.

We prepare for service based on the Torah readings. The event schedule is filled in when we set up venue.

The event schedule is filled in when we prepare for service. To set up venue, Jonathan uses the decorations. David is the one who tends to set up venue. It's Michael who gets to set up venue. To coordinate with venue, Sarah uses the event schedule. The guest list is what we go by when we coordinate with venue.

Thanks,
David

item.input:
Hi Lisa,

Here's roughly how the tv news desk side works.

We plan segment order based on the news schedule. You can't time segment slots without the news schedule. The source list is what we go by when we collect information. We always collect information before we verify facts.

To report live we need the result of the step where we report live. We also conduct interviews.

First we conduct interviews, then we report live. To collect information we need the result of the step where we write script. Sarah checks the news schedule before they write script. Animate graphics comes after: conduct interviews.

Lisa checks the news schedule before they edit script.

Time segment slots relies on whoever does the job to report live.

To plan segment order we need the result of the step where we conduct interviews. How we verify facts depends on how we edit script. Parking is a nightmare btw. It's Mark who gets to edit script. You can't edit script without the news script.

You have to write script before you can edit script.

Best,
Mark

Hello,

Here's roughly how the ambulance dispatch side works.

Check fuel and supplies needs the GPS tracking. On the reporting side: John checks the call outcomes before they provide feedback. To assign ambulance to call we need the result of the step where we contact assigned ambulance.

John is the one who tends to provide call details. The GPS tracking is what we go by when we log call outcome.

Parking is a nightmare btw.

Assess severity needs the symptom checklist. You can't check fuel and supplies without the supply inventory. You can't log call outcome without the call outcomes. You can't check fuel and supplies without the vehicle availability.

For dispatch, Lisa checks the vehicle availability before they assign ambulance to call.

I'll tidy this up later.

Thanks,
Tom

Ana

Hi Alex,

Here's roughly how the cybersecurity incident response side works.

The update security policies has to be sorted before the lessons learned document. 'train staff on new procedures' comes before 'lessons learned document'. The lessons learned document is Erin's job. The containment plan is what we go by when we implement the plan. The isolate affected systems has to be sorted before the containment plan.

'clean infected systems' comes before 'eradication log'.

The classify the incident type has to be sorted before the incident report.

Alex owns the recovery checklist. 'restore from backups' comes before 'recovery checklist'.

'verify system integrity' comes before 'recovery checklist'. We talked about this at the last meeting too. We also verify system integrity.

First we classify the incident type, then we monitor security systems.

You have to clean infected systems before you can restore from backups.

Security alerts is based on the incident report. We always train staff on new procedures before we monitor security systems. First we verify system integrity, then we update security policies.

The monitor security systems has to be sorted before the security alerts.

When we analyze alert data we look at the security alerts.

Thanks,
Jamie

Hi Zoe,

Here's roughly how the dog grooming salon side works.

Book appointments needs input from: wash the dog. You have to recommend products before you can wash the dog. You have to trim hair before you can handover the dog to the client. Trim hair comes after: dry the dog. We always handover the dog to the client before we advise on aftercare. Mia is in charge when we advise on aftercare. Handover the dog to the client needs the aftercare instructions. We advise on aftercare based on the aftercare instructions. Dry the dog comes after: wash the dog. Sales — you can't sell grooming products without the product inventory. Zoe checks the product inventory before they recommend products. Re cleaning: Olivia handles it when we need to clean the salon. We only clean the salon after we handover the dog to the client. How we trim hair depends on how we disinfect equipment.

On the cleaning side: Jake checks the grooming equipment before they clean the salon. Disinfect equipment needs the grooming equipment. Mia is the one who tends to check in dogs.

Thanks,
Jake

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the language school side works.

Provide tutoring sessions needs the learning resources. You have to provide tutoring sessions before you can offer academic counseling. It's Emma who gets to offer academic counseling. Re assessment: the student gradebook is what we go by when we provide feedback. Ava checks the student gradebook before they administer language tests. The teaching materials is what we go by when we review course content. There's a course syllabus. To review course content, Ava uses the course syllabus.

Re student recruitment: to conduct interviews, Liam uses the student recruitment brochure. There's also the student recruitment brochure. First we promote on social media, then we conduct interviews. The teaching materials pulls its numbers from the student workbook. Honestly nobody agrees whether 'provide tutoring sessions' is a support services thing or a teaching thing. The course syllabus draws on the lesson plan. Administer language tests comes after: deliver language lessons.

Olivia

Hi Alice,

Here's roughly how the coin and stamp dealer side works.

Update catalog entries relies on whoever does the job to assess item value.

Dave is the one who tends to record item location.

When we sell items to customers we look at the price list. The purchase contract is filled in when we update catalog entries.

Sell items to customers relies on whoever does the job to update catalog entries. First we update catalog entries, then we record item location. The transaction ledger is Carol's job. We keep a purchase contract. You can't assess item value without the reference books.

Assess item value relies on whoever does the job to negotiate purchase price. To update catalog entries, Bob uses the transaction ledger. Assess item value needs the appraisal tools. Not sure this is all of it but here goes.

Bob is in charge when we assess item value. Parking is a nightmare btw. Sell items to customers relies on whoever does the job to record item location. You can't negotiate purchase price without the purchase contract.

You can't record item location without the secure storage safe.

Cheers,
Alice

You have to deliver language lessons before you can provide tutoring sessions. When we deliver language lessons we look at the lesson plan. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. You can't deliver language lessons without the student workbook.

Thanks,
Emma

Someone needs to scout potential players.

Cheers,
Casey

Hi Max,

Here's roughly how the pet shop side works.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. To count stock weekly, Bella uses the inventory sheet.

Bella is in charge when we sell pets and supplies. Receive deliveries needs the inventory sheet. You can't sell pets and supplies without the inventory sheet.

You have to assist customers before you can sell pets and supplies. To order stock, Tom uses the list of suppliers.

Not sure this is all of it but here goes. The grooming schedule has to be sorted before the assist customers. Jake checks the grooming schedule before they groom pets.

Bella checks the sales register before they sell pets and supplies. First we order stock, then we receive deliveries. You can't order stock without the grooming schedule. To wash pets, Tom uses the grooming schedule.

The inventory sheet comes out of the step where we assist customers. There's a inventory sheet.

Cheers,
Tom

Hello,

Here's roughly how the skip hire company side works.

For collection, we always collect skips from site before we unload skips at depot. There's a booking calendar. We only transport skips to site after we load skips onto trucks.

When we collect skips from site we look at the collection checklist. New people always get confused by this. We assign equipment based on booking based on the booking calendar. Confirm booking details needs the booking calendar.

Best,
Kevin

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the self storage facility side works.

Lisa is the one who tends to generate statements. This has grown over the years. You can't generate statements without the invoice records. Lisa checks the maintenance schedule before they repair units and facilities. Inventorymanagement — Lisa checks the unit inventory before they update unit statuses. Accesscontrol — grant access to customers needs the access logs.

Repair units and facilities comes after: generate statements.

Clean units and common areas comes after: orientation tour of facility. Half of this lives in people's heads. Customeronboarding — there's also the storage contract.

Inventorymanagement — the unit inventory is Lisa's job. You can't orientation tour of facility without the storage contract. Chris checks the storage contract before they register customer details.

When we clean units and common areas we look at the maintenance schedule.

Best,
Hannah

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the parish council side works.

We only discuss items after we call to order. And of course we respond to inquiries. Mike is the one who tends to disburse funds. To disburse funds, Lisa uses the annual budget. The meeting agenda is built from the development plans. Report progress needs input from: adjourn meeting. Sarah is the one who tends to review proposals. You can't call to order without the meeting agenda. We keep a parish newsletter.

Call to order comes after: consult with stakeholders. The meeting agenda draws on the annual budget.

The parish newsletter is what we go by when we publicize events.

The development plans is what we go by when we consult with stakeholders. We respond to inquiries based on the parish newsletter.

The collect payments has to be sorted before the annual budget. You have to discuss items before you can adjourn meeting. The parish newsletter is what we go by when we update the parish website.

To draft plans, John uses the development plans. Report progress relies on whoever does the job to implement projects.

Lisa handles it when we need to publicize events. How we publicize events depends on how we implement projects. How we collect payments depends on how we implement projects. You have to draft plans before you can approve plans.

Best,
Lisa

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the game server operations side works.

The restoration history is what we go by when we select backup to restore.

Jamie looks after the backup retention policy.

You have to select backup to restore before you can restore game data. Taylor owns the backup retention policy.

The track health and performance has to be sorted before the monitoring dashboard. To create backups, Morgan uses the backup retention policy.

Scaling — we also scale server capacity. We only track health and performance after we scale server capacity. We also select backup to restore. Casey checks the scaling configuration before they monitor load. To restore game data, Jamie uses the backup retention policy. When we scale server capacity we look at the scaling configuration. Track health and performance needs input from: monitor load.

Best,
Taylor

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the dental clinic side works.

There's a sterilisation log. The sterilisation log is what we go by when we run the autoclave. It mostly works, honestly. First we clean instruments, then we run the autoclave. First we examine the patient, then we carry out treatment. Carry out treatment needs the treatment plan.

When we carry out treatment we look at the sterilisation log. Examine the patient comes after: check patients in.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense.

And of course we update medical history. Owen checks the appointment diary before they check patients in. When we book appointments we look at the appointment diary. There's also the appointment diary.

Best,
Owen

Hi Michael,

Here's roughly how the farmers market side works.

Setup stalls and structures needs the market layout plan.

Sarah is in charge when we transport goods to the market. Half of this lives in people's heads. When we setup stalls and structures we look at the market signage.

You have to transport goods to the market before you can register vendors.

To clean stalls and structures, Michael uses the waste management plan. I'll tidy this up later. We always clean stalls and structures before we pack up equipment. First we transport goods to the market, then we unload goods at the stalls.

When we transport goods to the market we look at the delivery schedule. Emily is in charge when we register vendors. The delivery schedule is what we go by when we check inventory.

Best,
Emily

item.input:
Hi Alex,

Here's roughly how the sailing club side works.

You can't perform maintenance without the boat fleet. On the training side: someone needs to teach sailing classes. Alex checks the event calendar before they send out notifications.

When we inspect boats and equipment we look at the safety checklist.

Re scheduling: we book sailing slots based on the event calendar. We also inspect boats and equipment. Perform maintenance needs the event calendar.

The book sailing slots has to be sorted before the boat fleet. When we inspect boats and equipment we look at the maintenance log. To register new members, Ethan uses the training schedule.

Alex checks the member roster before they register new members.

Ethan checks the training schedule before they evaluate skill levels. Beth handles it when we need to teach sailing classes. To teach sailing classes, Ethan uses the training schedule.

The maintenance log is what we go by when we perform maintenance.

To renew membership, Beth uses the member roster. Ethan is in charge when we register new members.

Cheers,
Carlos

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the street lighting maintenance side works.

How we tighten connections depends on how we test repaired lights. How we replace faulty bulbs depends on how we test repaired lights.

We always test repaired lights before we document repairs made.

Dana handles it when we need to visually check lights. There's also the issue report. The visually check lights has to be sorted before the issue report.

The measure brightness levels has to be sorted before the issue report. You can't document repairs made without the maintenance report. There's a available resources. When we test repaired lights we look at the lighting standards. To replace fualty bulbs, Dana uses the spare parts inventory. Dana is the one who tends to replace faulty bulbs. Carlos checks the spare parts inventory before they tighten connections.

Thanks,
Bob

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the garden centre side works.

New people always get confused by this. We always sell plants and supplies before we record sales. Record sales needs the sales receipts.

There's a sales receipts.

And of course we sell plants and supplies. First we arrange displays, then we maintain displays. Lisa checks the display plan before they arrange displays. We only care for plants after we grow plants. To care for plants, Lisa uses the plant list. When we arrange displays we look at the plant list.

We care for plants based on the stock sheet. To maintain displays we need the result of the step where we sell plants and supplies.

The stock sheet is what we go by when we sell plants and supplies.

To reorder when stock is low, Mark uses the stock sheet. We keep a stock sheet. We count stock weekly based on the stock sheet.

Best,
Mark

Hi all,

Here's roughly how the IT helpdesk side works.

We create user accounts based on the user directory. When we fix issues remotely we look at the ticket queue. First we log tickets, then we prioritise tickets. We only set up new laptops after we create user accounts. You can't fix issues remotely without the knowledge base.

Lou checks the user directory before they fix issues remotely.

Raj checks the asset register before they prioritise tickets. For intake, log tickets needs the ticket queue. Set up new laptops needs the user directory.

Someone needs to create user accounts. It's Petra who gets to create user accounts.

The asset register is what we go by when we set up new laptops. We set up new laptops based on the licence list. When we reset passwords we look at the user directory.

We also fix issues remotely. Raj checks the ticket queue before they visit desks.

Cheers,
Raj

Hello,

Here's roughly how the payroll bureau side works.

Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. First we calculate gross pay, then we apply tax and deductions. First we process payroll transactions, then we schedule bank transfers. You can't apply tax and deductions without the payroll transactions.

The process payroll transactions has to be sorted before the payroll transactions. 'generate payroll report' comes before 'payroll report'.

People disagree about who owns 'apply tax and deductions': some say calculation, some say processing. Emily is the one who tends to calculate gross pay.

Best,
Tom

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the coffee roastery side works.

Roast batches depends on: package the coffee. How we roast beans depends on how we measure roast profiles. You have to roast beans before you can cool the roasted beans. When we package the coffee we look at the product labels. Lucy is the one who tends to measure roast profiles.

Ethan is in charge when we cool the roasted beans.

To measure roast profiles, Ethan uses the quality standards.

Cool the roasted beans needs the roast batches.

Half of this lives in people's heads. We only seal the packaging after we package the coffee. To cupping evaluation, Ethan uses the quality standards.

Cheers,
Lucy

Isabella

Hi Jack,

Here's roughly how the scaffolding firm side works.

On the documentation side: to record job details, Brian uses the work logs.

The inspection report is what we go by when we record job details. Inspection report is based on the job plan. The work logs is what we go by when we dismantle scaffolding. We talked about this at the last meeting too. It's Linda who gets to dismantle scaffolding.

Half of this lives in people's heads.

It's Jack who gets to store dismantled materials. You can't store dismantled materials without the storage location for materials. We always dismantle scaffolding before we store dismantled materials.

Best,
Jack

item.input:
Hi all,

Here's roughly how the local newspaper side works.

David checks the layout template before they arrange articles on page. You have to load the trucks before you can deliver newspapers. We always proofread articles before we format articles for print.

David is the one who tends to format articles for print. We also proofread articles.

To arrange articles on page we need the result of the step where we prepare the press.

We keep a reporter notes. You have to conduct interviews before you can research topics. Format articles for print needs input from: arrange articles on page.

Deliver newspapers relies on whoever does the job to print the newspaper.

Research topics relies on whoever does the job to proofread articles. First we prepare the press, then we print the newspaper. The reporter notes gets updated whenever we proofread articles. Print the newspaper needs input from: load the trucks. We arrange articles on page based on the image library. Lisa is the one who tends to arrange articles on page. Lisa looks after the image library. The style guide is what we go by when we proofread articles. It's Brian who gets to print the newspaper. When we load the trucks we look at the delivery route map. To prepare the press, Carlos uses the final edition files. Carlos is in charge when we proofread articles.

Conduct interviews needs the reporter notes.

Cheers,
Emma

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the property letting agency side works.

This has grown over the years. We pay landlords based on the landlord statement.

We only pay landlords after we collect rent. You can't run viewings without the safety certificates. It mostly works, honestly. When we send a contractor we look at the landlord statement. 'do rental valuations' comes before 'property adverts'. The property adverts has to be sorted before the run viewings. The safety certificates is what we go by when we book gas safety checks. Amara checks the repairs log before they send a contractor. There's a repairs log.

Best,
Amara

item.input:
Hi Emily,

Here's roughly how the council housing repairs side works.

Emily checks the repair materials before they perform repair.

Someone needs to update property database.

The examine the damage has to be sorted before the damage report. Ask me if anything doesn't make sense. Michael is the one who tends to mark repair as complete. 'mark repair as complete' comes before 'repair completion record'. To estimate materials, Sarah uses the damage report. You can't update property database without the repair completion record. First we examine the damage, then we perform repair. Mark repair as complete comes after: perform repair.

There's also the repair request form. And of course we validate request details.

Best,
Emily

Cheers,
Emily

The cocktail recipe is what we go by when we mix cocktails. And of course we mix cocktails.

We count stock weekly based on the stock sheet. And of course we count stock weekly. Pour cocktails needs the menu.

When we serve guests we look at the menu.

Best,
Finn

Hello,

Here's roughly how the dental clinic side works.

Submit insurance claims needs the patient notes.

The patient notes is Dr Patel's job. Examine the patient comes after: check patients in. You can't book apponitments without the appointment diary.

We only carry out treatment after we examine the patient. Check patients in needs the appointment diary. It's Owen who gets to invoice the patient.

We also book appointments.

The patient notes is what we go by when we update medical history. The treatment plan pulls its numbers from the patient notes. We carry out treatment based on the treatment plan. The treatment plan is what we go by when we invoice the patient. And of course we examine the patient.

When we examine the patient we look at the patient notes. Invoice the patient needs the fee schedule.

Thanks,
Dr Patel

item.input:
Hey team,

Here's roughly how the property letting agency side works.

When we send a contractor we look at the landlord statement.

Tenancy — it's Hugo who gets to reference tenants. The tenancy agreement draws on the property adverts. The reference tenants has to be sorted before the tenancy agreement. You can't book gas safety checks without the safety certificates. The coffee machine is broken again. Tenancy agreement is based on the safety certificates. The tenancy agreement is what we go by when we collect rent. 'do rental valuations' comes before 'property adverts'. On the maintenance side: you can't send a contractor without the repairs log. The property adverts has to be sorted before the run viewings. Amara checks the safety certificates before they run viewings.

Re rent: pay landlords needs the landlord statement. First we collect rent, then we pay landlords. Compliance — Amara owns the safety certificates.

Cheers,
Hugo

Mei

Hey team,

Here's roughly how the archaeological dig side works.

The site map is Bob's job. We locate potential areas based on the site map.

Record findings relies on whoever does the job to input data into the catalog.

Input data into the catalog needs the artifact catalog. Bob checks the excavation trenches before they conduct excavations.

First we conduct excavations, then we record findings. Someone needs to record findings.

Best,
Bob

Here's roughly how the pr-agency side works.

Pitch stories to media needs the media contact list. How we define key messages depends on how we write press materials. David checks the client updates before they provide briefs to client.

'campaign plan' comes before 'define key messages'.

The client updates is Lisa's job. The campaign plan is what we go by when we define key messages.

Someone needs to define key messages.

We gather client feedback based on the client updates. The press release comes out of the step where we pitch stories to media. First we research media outlets, then we pitch stories to media. The campaign plan is what we go by when we provide briefs to client. To gather client feedback, Emily uses the campaign plan. This has grown over the years. To research media outlets, Lisa uses the campaign plan.

Lisa is the one who tends to analyze public sentiment. The press release is what we go by when we review content for accuracy. David owns the press release. Review content for accuracy comes after: write press materials.

Cheers,
Lisa

Here's roughly how the trade union branch side works.

Cheers,
